Description:
Company Overview
OYU Green is a global climate solutions leader across 10+ countries, partnering with Fortune 500 companies and developing impactful carbon-reduction & removal projects while directing climate finance to vulnerable communities. Join the climate movementwork across renewable energy, clean cooking, energy efficiency, fuel-switching & afforestation, unlocking carbon revenues and creating tangible impact for a sustainable future.

Role Description
Own relationships. Create opportunities. Drive growth.
As a Client Relationship Executive/Manager at OYU Green, you’ll be based on-site in Bhopal & Gurugram. Client Relationship Executive/Manager is a full-time role focused on managing client relationships, generating new business opportunities, and coordinating with internal teams to support project execution and business growth. The role involves client engagement, lead generation and qualification, business outreach, proposal coordination, pipeline management, documentation, and timely follow-ups from initial contact through project execution.

Roles & Responsibilities
Own client and prospect relationships, understand requirements, address queries, and ensure a smooth experience throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify target clients, partners, and opportunities; conduct multi-channel outreach and nurture qualified leads.
Qualify opportunities, maintain CRM/pipeline records, coordinate meetings, proposals, negotiations, and follow-ups through closure.
Coordinate with clients and internal teams on documentation, deliverables, timelines, and action items to ensure smooth project execution.
Build strategic stakeholder relationships, track market and sector developments, and contribute to outreach, conversion, retention, and revenue targets.
Required Skills
3+ years of experience as a Client Relationship Executive/Manager
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build, maintain, and strengthen long-term client relationships.
Excellent follow-up, stakeholder coordination, problem-solving, and ability to proactively resolve client queries and concerns.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, project timelines, documentation, CRM records, and follow-ups accurately.
Understanding of client requirements, business development opportunities, presentation, negotiation, and effective coordination with cross-functional teams.

About Us
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About the Team

As a service-focused team, we operate in a fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges, and our goal is to ensure that every merchant interaction ends with a positive experience.

About the Role
Handle merchant escalations and resolve them on a high-priority basis.
Proactively assist merchants to ensure timely and effective resolution of issues.Deliver exceptional merchant satisfaction through ownership and accountability of cases.

Key Responsibilities / Expectations
Resolve merchant complaints received through RBI, nodal officers, social media channels, or senior management escalations.
Understand the nature of each query, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure resolution within defined TATs.
Prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for escalations received.
Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.
Maintain high CSAT scores and ensure no repeat escalations for handled cases.
Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

About the Role
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive who has good hands-on experience in e-commerce and understands how digital marketing contributes to sales and customer growth.
The person will mainly handle SEO, social media, content marketing, email marketing, customer research, competitor research, and marketing analytics.
You should be comfortable working with different teams, understanding what customers are looking for, and turning those insights into useful marketing campaigns and content.
You will also work closely with the Performance Marketing team to make sure our organic and paid marketing activities are working together.

What You Will Be Doing
1. E-commerce Marketing
Plan and execute digital marketing activities for our e-commerce business.
Understand our products, customers, competitors, offers, and USPs.
Help plan campaigns around new products, offers, festivals, and important business events.
Look for new ways to increase brand visibility, customer engagement, traffic, and sales.
Work with the performance marketing team and creative team on campaign planning.
Keep track of what is working and what needs to be improved.
2. SEO
Do keyword research for products, categories, and relevant topics.
Find keywords that potential customers are actually searching for.
Work on on-page SEO for product and category pages.
Optimize titles, descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, and images.
Track rankings, organic traffic, clicks, impressions, and CTR.
Use Google Search Console and SEO tools to find new opportunities.
Check competitors and understand what they are doing differently.
Work with the content team to create SEO-focused content.
Identify products and categories where we have an opportunity to grow organically.
3. Content Marketing
Plan content around our products and target customers.
Come up with content ideas based on customer questions, problems, and interests.
Work on ideas for:
Product education
Product benefits
FAQs
Product comparisons
Customer reviews
Testimonials
UGC
How-to content
Problem/solution content
Prepare and manage the monthly content calendar.
Coordinate with designers, video editors, creators, and copywriters.
Look at content performance and understand what type of content gets better response.
Turn customer questions and objections into content ideas.
4. Social Media
Manage the brand's organic social media presence.
Plan and publish content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn, depending on the brand's requirements.
Plan Reels, posts, carousels, stories, and other relevant formats.
Keep up with relevant trends and find ways to use them for the brand.
Coordinate with the creative team for content production.
Monitor reach, engagement, saves, shares, views, profile visits, and website clicks.
Identify content that performs well and find ways to build on it.
Keep an eye on competitors and their social media activity.
The goal isn't simply to increase followers. We want content that gets people interested in the brand and products.
5. Email & Customer Retention
Plan and execute email marketing campaigns.
Maintain and segment customer lists.
Create campaigns for:
New customers
Existing customers
Repeat customers
Abandoned carts
Product education
Cross-sell and upsell
Promotions
Customer reactivation
Track email performance including open rate, CTR, conversions, revenue, and unsubscribes.
Look for opportunities to increase repeat purchases and customer engagement.
Experience with WhatsApp marketing or CRM automation will be an advantage.

Understand what customers like, dislike, and expect from the brand.
Go through customer reviews, comments, questions, and feedback.
Identify common customer doubts and objections.
Research competitors' products, pricing, offers, content, and positioning.
Keep track of market trends and new opportunities.

Senior Performance Marketing Specialist Meta Ads
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: In-Office

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Specialist with strong hands-on experience in Meta Ads and e-commerce marketing.
This person will be responsible for managing the paid acquisition side of the business, with Meta Ads as the primary channel. You will be expected to take ownership of campaign strategy, execution, optimization, scaling, reporting, and overall paid-media performance.
We are looking for someone who understands that good performance marketing is not just about getting a low CPC or high CTR. The focus should be on generating profitable sales, acquiring the right customers, and finding sustainable ways to scale the business.
The role will work closely with the Digital Marketing, Creative, Content, and Management teams.

Key Responsibilities
1. Own Meta Ads From Strategy to Execution
Take complete ownership of the brand's Meta advertising account and paid-media strategy.
Plan campaigns according to business goals, product margins, customer acquisition targets, and available budget.
Build and manage campaigns for e-commerce sales, lead generation, remarketing, and other relevant objectives.
Decide how the account should be structured based on the product, audience, funnel, and campaign objective.
Manage campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
Review account performance regularly and make decisions on what to scale, maintain, restructure, test, or stop.
Keep the account organized and maintain clear naming, campaign structures, audiences, creatives, and reporting.

2. Audience & Customer Strategy
Develop audience strategies for both new customer acquisition and retargeting.
Work with broad targeting, Custom Audiences, Lookalikes, website visitors, customer lists, purchasers, product viewers, video viewers, and social engagers where relevant.
Use first-party customer data to improve targeting and customer acquisition.
Understand the difference between high-intent and low-intent audiences.
Monitor audience saturation, frequency, and changes in audience quality.
Adjust targeting based on actual campaign and customer data rather than relying on assumptions.

3. Creative Strategy
At a senior level, the candidate should be able to tell the creative team what needs to be tested and why.
Develop creative testing plans based on product, customer behavior, and campaign performance.
Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, benefits, objections, and messaging opportunities.
Work with designers, video editors, UGC creators, and content teams to produce new ad creatives.
Test different formats such as UGC, Reels, product demonstrations, testimonials, static ads, and other suitable formats.
Analyze creative performance and identify fatigue before it significantly affects campaign results.
Turn winning creative insights into new variations rather than repeatedly using the same ad.
Maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative ideas and tests.

4. Performance Analysis & Optimization
The candidate should be able to look at an account and understand where the problem actually is.
Monitor and analyze metrics including:
CPM | CTR | CPC | Frequency | Landing Page Views | Add to Cart | Checkout | Purchases | CPA | CAC | ROAS | Revenue | AOV
The candidate should be able to investigate situations such as:
CPM increasing unexpectedly.
CTR falling while CPM remains stable.
Good CTR but poor conversion rate.
Good conversion rate but poor ROAS.
Rising CPA despite stable traffic.
Strong ROAS but insufficient purchase volume.
A previously successful creative suddenly declining.
Retargeting becoming expensive because of audience saturation.
Optimization decisions should be based on data, customer behavior, economics, and the overall funnel, not on one metric in isolation.

5. Budget Management & Scaling
Manage daily, weekly, and monthly advertising budgets.
Decide where budget should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.
Build controlled scaling plans for winning campaigns, products, audiences, and creatives.
Understand the difference between scaling spend and scaling profitable revenue.
Monitor CAC, CPA, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, and contribution margin where data is available.
Prepare budget forecasts and expected performance scenarios.
Identify when performance is limited by budget, audience size, creative volume, offer, or conversion rate.
Make scaling decisions without sacrificing the overall economics of the business.

6. Tracking, Measurement & Attribution
Strong tracking knowledge is required for this role.
Manage and troubleshoot Meta Pixel/Dataset and Events Manager.
Understand events such as View Content, Add to Cart, Initiate Checkout, Purchase, and Lead.
Work with Conversions API (CAPI) and understand the role of server-side event tracking.
Check whether important events are being received correctly and consistently.
Work with developers or technical teams when tracking issues need to be resolved.

Job Title: US IT Recruiter Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0–5+ Years
Shift: Night Shift – US Staffing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels — Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.
The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.
Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.
Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations
Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–5 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (5+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.

We preferably look for local candidates based in Ooty / Coorg / Puducherry. If you're interested, kindly apply.

Trrip Partner Verification Executive (PVE)

Job Description (JD) & Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

PART A JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Position
Designation: Partner Verification Executive (PVE)
Role Type: Field-Based
Location: Ooty / Coorg / Puducherry

Reporting To: Trrip Operations Team
Role Objective
The PVE is responsible for physically visiting locations assigned by Trrip and collecting fresh, accurate and complete information directly from the partner. The objective is to provide Trrip with reliable, up-to-date partner information, images and customer-useful details.
Visit Target
The PVE will be assigned approximately 55 to 60 restaurants and/or shops to visit as part of the assigned field activity. All assigned locations must be physically visited and properly verified according to this SOP.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Physical Verification
- Visit restaurants, shops and other locations assigned by Trrip.
- Physically verify that the location is operational.
- Confirm the business name and address.
- Meet the owner, manager or authorized contact person.
- Collect the correct contact person's name and number.
- Capture geo-tagged proof of the visit.
B. Partner Data Collection
- Business name
- Contact person's name and number
- WhatsApp number, if available
- Complete address and landmark
- Operating days and timings
- Services/products offered
- Other relevant partner details
C. Images & Menu Collection
- Capture minimum 5 fresh interior/location images.
- Capture exterior/name-board image.
- Capture relevant product, service and facility images where applicable.
- Collect the latest menu, rate card or brochure where applicable.
- Use Microsoft Lens, Adobe Scan or an equivalent scanning application.
- Ensure all images are clear, relevant and readable.

PART B STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE
PHASE 1
Receive Assignment
- Receive the list of restaurants, shops or other locations from Trrip.
- The assigned list will generally contain approximately 50 to 60 locations.
- Review the assigned locations.
- Plan the route and visits.
- Visit locations according to the assigned schedule.
PHASE 2
Physical Visit
Step 1: Reach the Location
- Physically visit the assigned location.
- Online verification does not count as a completed visit.

Step 2: Geo-Tagged Proof
- Keep location/GPS enabled.
- Capture a fresh exterior image showing the name board/entrance wherever possible.

Step 3: Meet the Partner
- Speak with the owner, manager or authorized representative.
- Explain that you are collecting updated information for Trrip.
PHASE 3
Collect & Verify Information
- Confirm directly with the partner: name, address, contact person, contact number, WhatsApp number, operating hours, services/products and other relevant information.
- Do not simply copy information from Google or other online platforms.
PHASE 4
Images & Menu Collection
- Capture 1 exterior/name-board image.
- Capture minimum 5 fresh interior/location images.
- Capture relevant product, service and facility images where applicable.
- Collect the latest menu, rate card or brochure where applicable.
- Use Microsoft Lens, Adobe Scan or an equivalent scanning application.
- Ensure there is no blur, glare or unnecessary shadow and that relevant pages are fully visible and readable.
- Do not submit images downloaded from Google, Instagram, Zomato, Swiggy, Justdial or other websites/platformsas fresh PVE photographs.
PHASE 5
Data Submission
- Submit partner details, contact details, address, services/products offered, fresh photographs, geo-tagged proof, menu/rate card where applicable and additional notes.
- If information is unavailable, write Not Provided.
- Never guess, assume or fabricate information.

PVE Principle
Visit Physically > Collect Directly > Verify Accurately > Submit Completely

Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Overview
Service Managers (SM) or Territory Managers (TM) are the frontline owner of fleet quality, safety compliance and ground-level service execution resulting in top-notch customer experience.
Core Responsibilities
Service Quality –
1. Completing daily in-bus inspections and fill the audit form to improve service delivery
2. Own audit score and bus-quality-complaints-per-trip metric, and zero compromise on safety violations
3. Ensure cleanliness, comfort and onboard amenities meet brand standard on every trip
4. Daily coordination with operator staff to get the work done and highlighting improvement areas
5. Calling unhappy customers daily and gather captain & crew feedback to close the loop; resolve issues at the right quality, not just speed
6. Working on reducing customer complaints related to bus condition, cleanliness and safety concerns
 Team Leadership & Accountability -
1. Recruit, train and manage the team of bus captains ensuring grooming standards and timely reporting
2. Own roster planning, week-offs, attendance and attrition control
3. Drive accountability through audits and performance evaluation; log corrective actions against the SOP checklist; keep behavioral complaints under check
4. Deliver on customer engagement targets of customer ratings and in-bus bookings
 Reporting & Continuous Improvement -
1. Own the reports assigned to this role, flag trends and make corrections
2. Monitor service and captain level performance through performance dashboards
3. Bus punctuality reports to be seen daily and making timely schedule/route corrections
4. Log daily checklist of SOPs and ensure team down the line improve on deliverables
 Required Skills & Availability
 Working knowledge of bus systems, fleet maintenance basics and safety regulations
 Proven people-management and training ability for a frontline team
 Composure and firmness enforcing standards under operational pressure, including the authority to hold a bus back from dispatch
 Strong coordination and stakeholder communication — captains, crew, customers and the operator
 Comfortable working late nights and staying reachable off-hours while services are running

Position Description:
Oversee strategic planning, implementation, and optimisation of facility operations, ensuring a seamless, safe, and efficient work environment aligned with organisational objectives. The role also supports basic IT infrastructure coordination to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

Primary Responsibilities:
Strategically oversee and optimise the utilisation of physical spaces, resources, and services to enhance workplace functionality, employee well-being, and overall operational efficiency.
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive facility management policies, procedures, and sustainability initiatives in alignment with organisational goals and industry best practices.
Manage budgets related to repairs, renovations, remodelling, and new construction projects, ensuring cost efficiency and timely execution.
Plan and schedule work for staff and external vendors; supervise operations including CCTV management, event management, canteen services, DG sets, HVAC (AC), fire safety systems, waste management, security services, and overall vendor management.

Ensure compliance with safety, security, and statutory regulations across facilities and support smooth day-to-day operations.

Bachelors degree in Facility Management, Engineering, Operations, Administration, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in facility management, administration, or infrastructure operations.
Strong knowledge of building maintenance, HVAC, DG sets, CCTV, fire safety systems, security, and vendor management.
Experience in budget management, cost optimisation, renovations, and facility improvement projects.
Knowledge of statutory compliance, workplace safety standards, and sustainability practices.
Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, including network connectivity, hardware installation, system maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Strong leadership, team management, vendor coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Office and facility management tools.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, handle emergencies, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

Use appropriate digital tools and innovative teaching methodologies to enhance student learning.
Maintain professional relationships with students, faculty members, parents, and other stakeholders.
Perform other academic and administrative duties assigned by the Head of the Department or competent authority.
Qualifications
Master’s Degree in English / English Literature or a relevant discipline from a recognized university.
UGC-NET / SLET / SET / Ph.D. as applicable, in accordance with prevailing regulatory requirements.
Strong communication, presentation, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Prior teaching experience in a higher-education institution will be an added advantage.

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.

Description:
Position: Floor Manager (Supermarket)

Industry: Supermarket / Hypermarket / Retail
Department: Store Operations
Reporting To: Store Manager
Location: Villianur & Pondicherry
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose
The Floor Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the supermarket sales floor, ensuring excellent customer service, effective staff deployment, proper product availability and display, and smooth store operations to achieve sales target.
The role requires strong leadership, customer-handling, merchandising, inventory-control and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

1. Floor Operations
Manage daily sales-floor operations and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
Ensure the store is ready for business before opening and properly managed until closing.
Monitor customer flow and ensure a clean, organized and pleasant shopping environment.
Conduct regular floor walks and identify operational issues.
Coordinate with back-store, warehouse, billing and other departments for smooth operations.
2. Team Management
Supervise and guide sales staff, department staff, promoters and support employees.
Allocate staff to departments based on business requirements and customer traffic.
Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming and discipline.
Conduct daily briefings and communicate targets, promotions and operational instructions.
Coach employees on customer service, product knowledge and selling techniques.
Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
3. Sales & Target Achievement
Drive daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.
Monitor department-wise sales performance and identify gaps.
Encourage upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure promotional activities and offers are properly communicated to customers.
Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products and take corrective action with the relevant teams.
4. Stock & Inventory Management
Ensure shelves are adequately stocked and products are replenished on time.
Monitor stock availability and coordinate with inventory/warehouse teams.
Ensure proper FIFO/FEFO practices, particularly for grocery, dairy, fresh and perishable products.
Identify damaged, expired, near-expiry and slow-moving products.
Support stock counts, audits and inventory reconciliation.
Monitor stock discrepancies and assist in shrinkage/loss-prevention control.
5. Merchandising & Display
Ensure products are displayed according to company merchandising standards.
Maintain correct pricing, labels, shelf tags and promotional displays.
Ensure planograms and promotional displays are implemented correctly where applicable.
Maintain attractive, clean and well-organized shelves and aisles.
6. Customer Service
Ensure customers receive prompt and professional service.
Handle customer queries, complaints and escalations effectively.
Resolve routine customer issues and escalate major issues to the Store Manager.
Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the shopping experience.
7. Billing & Cash Operations
Monitor billing-counter operations during peak hours.
Ensure adequate cashier deployment.
Coordinate with the cashier/team to minimize billing queues.
Support accurate billing and cash-handling procedures.
Report billing or POS-related issues promptly.
8. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance
Ensure cleanliness and hygiene standards are maintained throughout the sales floor.
Ensure employees follow company policies, safety procedures and grooming standards.
Monitor food-safety requirements in applicable departments.
Report safety hazards, equipment issues and other operational risks immediately.
9. Reporting & Administration
Prepare or provide daily operational updates to the Store Manager.
Monitor sales, stock availability, customer complaints, staff attendance and other relevant KPIs.
Maintain records related to floor operations.
Support internal audits, stock audits and management inspections.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of daily/monthly sales targets
Sales growth and conversion
Customer satisfaction
Stock availability / out-of-stock percentage
Shrinkage and stock-loss control
Inventory accuracy
Staff productivity and attendance
Shelf/display compliance
Customer complaint resolution
Store hygiene and operational standards
Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline preferred.
Diploma/12th standard may be considered based on experience.
Experience
3+ years of experience in supermarket, hypermarket, grocery retail or general retail operations.
Previous experience as Floor Manager, Department Supervisor, Senior Sales Executive, Store Supervisor or equivalent is preferred.
Experience managing a team in a high-footfall retail environment is an advantage

Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing customers to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight

Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling

Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.

Responsibilities

Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores
In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary

Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think / entrepreneur mind-set etc.

Interested candidates can mail their CV at preetika.arora@lenskart.in or whatsapp at 9818320725

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority

The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. Team Work

Documentation

Working Hours

Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training

Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.

Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores

a.Bridge communication between Management and floor

b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Position: Sales Head
Location: Manipur

Profile:
Target-Based SalesAbout the RoleWe are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Head to lead and expand our sales operations in Manipur. Generate new business opportunities and expand the company's customer base.
Negotiate with dealers, distributors, and customers regarding pricing, orders, schemes, and commercial terms.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions wherever required.
Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, product availability, dispatches, payments, and customer support.
Prepare regular sales reports, market updates, and sales forecasts for management.
Monitor competitor pricing, products, schemes, and market activities.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments from dealers and distributors.

5+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Channel Sales.
Relevant experience in Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Strong experience in dealer and distributor handling.
Proven track record of achieving target-based sales.
Strong understanding of the Manipur market.
Required Skills
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Strong knowledge of market development and channel management.
Ability to effectively deal with dealers, distributors, retailers, and customers.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Good understanding of sales targets, business development, and revenue generation.
Strong networking and relationship-management abilities.
Willingness to travel extensively across the market.
Ability to work in a highly target-oriented environment.

ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Saleforce DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Salesforce DevOps practices and tools such as Copado, Git, and Azure DevOps (ADO). The candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, enabling efficient, reliable, and scalable release management across Salesforce environments.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce using Copado and ADO.
Manage source control strategy with Git (branching, merging, conflict resolution).
Automate deployments across multiple Salesforce environments, ensuring alignment with governance and compliance requirements.
Collaborate with development teams to define DevOps best practices and enforce coding standards.
Support release management activities, including planning, monitoring, and issue resolution.
Integrate testing, code quality checks, and security scans into the deployment pipeline.
Provide troubleshooting support for deployment issues and perform root cause analysis.
Create documentation, knowledge base articles, and training to upskill development teams.
Work closely with stakeholders (functional, technical, QA, and business) to ensure seamless delivery.
Required Skills & Experience
48 years of overall IT experience with 3+ years in Salesforce DevOps.
Hands-on experience with Copado (mandatory).
Strong knowledge of Git-based workflows (feature branching, pull requests, code review).
Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines and work item tracking.
Familiarity with Salesforce metadata, SFDX, and package-based deployments.
Knowledge of release management processes in large-scale enterprise environments.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot deployment failures.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Gearset, AutoRABIT, or other Salesforce DevOps tools.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization concepts.
Knowledge of test automation tools (Selenium, Provar, etc.) integrated with CI/CD.
Salesforce certifications (Admin/Platform Developer) and Copado certifications.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support

Workflow & System Administration Support

Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.

PLM Data Model Understanding

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data

Job Description Summary
Insurance Follow-Up:
Contact insurance companies via phone, email, or online portals to follow up on outstanding claims. Identify and resolve issues causing payment delays, such as claim denials or underpayments. Verify claim status, appeal denied claims, and resubmit claims when necessary.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of all communications and actions taken. Update account information and billing systems with payment details and follow-up notes. Generate reports on accounts receivable status, aging trends, and collection efforts.
Compliance and Regulations: Adhere to HIPAA regulations and guidelines to ensure patient confidentiality and data security. Stay informed about insurance policies, billing guidelines, and industry changes affecting reimbursement.
Team Collaboration: Collaborate with internal departments, including billing, coding, and collections teams, to resolve payment issues. Participate in meetings and discussions to improve revenue cycle processes and workflow.
PMS Experience: Epic HB or PB experience is Mandatory
Requirements: SP
Proven experience (6months-3years) in healthcare revenue cycle management, specifically in accounts receivable follow-up and collections.
Strong understanding of medical billing processes, insurance claims, and reimbursement methodologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with insurance companies, patients, and internal stakeholders.
Proficiency in using billing software, electronic health records (EHR), and Microsoft Office applications.
Attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
Knowledge of medical coding (ICD-10, CPT) is a plus.
Experience Level: 6months to 3 years.
Shift timings: Flexible to work in night shifts (US Time zone)
Preferred Qualification: Bachelors degree in finance or Any Graduate

Hi Everyone,
Hope youre doing well!
We have an urgent opening for a SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant of our esteemed clients.

Experience Required: 10 – 15 Years
Location: Hyderabad,Bangalore,Pune,Mumbai,Noida,Chennai
Employment Type: Full-time
Education: B. Tech / M. Tech / M.Sc. / MCA

Position Overview
Job Descripition:

We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant with 9+ years of expertise in SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, global template rollouts, business process analysis, and SAP implementations. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, conducting workshops, gathering requirements, configuring SAP SD solutions, supporting testing activities, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Lead workshops with business users and stakeholders to define functional requirements.
Configure and support SAP SD processes, including Sales, Shipping, Delivery, Billing, Pricing, and O2C.
Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and global rollout projects.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments.
Support SIT, UAT, defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including MM, FI, WM/EWM, and Logistics.
Create and maintain functional documentation and provide end-user support.
Ensure solution quality, process compliance, and timely project delivery.

Required Skills
9+ years of SAP SD Functional experience.
Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
Experience in SAP implementations, enhancements, and global rollouts.
Expertise in Sales Order Processing, Pricing, Shipping, Delivery, and Billing.
Experience in business process analysis, configuration, testing, and production support.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of SAP integration with MM and FI modules.

Preferred Candidate
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.
Exposure to Agile or SAP Activate methodology.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Additional Job Description

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Oracle HCM Functional - Senior Manager, you will specialize in providing consulting services for Oracle human capital management applications, analyzing client requirements, implementing HCM software solutions, and offering training and support for seamless integration. Within our Workforce Technology - Oracle HCM practice, you will enable clients to optimize their human resources processes, enhance talent management, and achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach teams to solve complex problems, applying sound judgment to recognize when to take action and when to escalate. Your role involves crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story, applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems, and validating outcomes with clients. You will direct teams through complexity, demonstrating composure in challenging situations, and initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on achieving results and maintaining operational excellence, interacting with clients at a strategic level to drive overall project success. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, along with your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation of Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions to optimize client human resources processes
- Analyzing client requirements and designing tailored Oracle HCM solutions to meet strategic objectives
- Providing training and support to clients for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle HCM applications
- Collaborating with clients to enhance talent management and workforce planning through Oracle HCM tools
- Managing project budgets and timelines to deliver successful Oracle HCM implementations
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher and Oracle SQL Developer for data analysis and reporting
- Driving business process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency in human resources
- Coaching and mentoring teams to solve complex problems and deliver quality results
- Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities within client organizations
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients to understand and address their human capital needs
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 20+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Human Resources Management, Business Administration/Management, Psychology, Organizational Leadership, Management Information Systems
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Human Capital Management or related Oracle HCM Cloud applications
- Demonstrating advanced skills in Oracle HCM Cloud implementations
- Leading strategic human resource planning initiatives
- Managing complex Oracle HCM workforce transformation projects
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher for data-driven insights
- Excelling in coaching and developing high-performing teams
