Description:
Responsibilities
1. Jira Tool Configuration & Administration
Execute assigned Jira and integrated-tool support tickets (Approvals, Rework, Mobilization, Handover, Urgent requests, Change Requests) within SLA and quality standards while communicating proactively with reporters on requirements and status updates.
Create and configure Jira spaces, projects, workflows, schemes, user roles, permissions, fields, boards, and plugins (Structure, Rich Filters, Xray, ScriptRunner) based on standard procedures and templates, adapting configurations for engagement needs while maintaining governance standards. Troubleshoot complex Jira and Confluence issues, evaluate solutions, document changes, and coordinate resolution with technical and functional stakeholders.
2. Reporting, Analytics & Functional Requirements
Gather and translate business and engagement requirements into Jira configurations, dashboards, reports, and delivery solutions. Create and maintain Rich Filter dashboards, Kanban and Scrum boards, and project reporting standards using AI/automation where appropriate to improve efficiency and accuracy. Validate expectations with reporters and stakeholders before implementation.
Use advanced JQL to investigate and resolve client inquiries, build reporting views, and provide data-driven insights for delivery teams. Support project forecasting, progress tracking, resource/capacity visibility, and
management reporting using Jira and other PMO/collaboration tools as engagement needs require.
3. Agile, Scrum & Project Delivery
Apply knowledge of the complete project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, closure) to support timely, quality delivery. Take on Project Manager or Scrum Master responsibilities on selected engagements, including facilitation of Agile ceremonies, backlog/sprint coordination, dependency tracking, and team alignment.
Digitize schedules and plans using tools such as Structure for Jira, Advanced Roadmaps/Plans, MS Project, ServiceNow, or Smartsheet, adapting to client and practice methodologies.
4. Governance, Risk & Delivery Support
Define clear objectives, scope, deliverables, and milestones for proposed solutions. Track progress to ensure delivery outcomes meet agreed quality standards and create Change Requests based on governance requirements and approvals.
Identify, document, and track risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation actions through closure. Escalate urgent requests and delivery concerns to leadership as appropriate.
Perform advanced Jira administrative activities including MPP uploads, bulk updates, and project configuration changes. Configure Test Management with Xray to enable functional teams with testing workflows, reports, and traceability. Support PMO governance activities, project tracking, documentation, and quality checks across different engagement processes.
5. Stakeholder Management, Training & Communication
Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate proactively with engagement teams, clients, and ticket reporters on requirements, scope, priorities, progress, risks, and completion. Facilitate working sessions, Agile ceremonies, requirement discussions, and project status conversations to align stakeholders on goals, deliverables, and timelines.
Deliver on-demand Jira/Confluence and process training, maintain training materials and knowledge articles, and support user adoption across technical and functional audiences. Mentor team members, build enduring client relationships, and collaborate across PwC practices and technology platforms as engagement assignments change.
6. Quality, Continuous Improvement & Operations
Identify opportunities to streamline Jira administration and PMO processes through standardization, automation, AI, and reusable tools/templates. Measure improvements in efficiency, quality, and SLA performance. Operate effectively in environments without a single fixed process, quickly ramping up on new domains, platforms, client-specific tools, and ways of working.
Perform peer reviews and quality checks, attend team meetings and mandatory trainings, and maintain consistent documentation and delivery standards. Execute ad hoc tasks and special assignments from senior management, prioritizing appropriately and maintaining proactive communication.
7. Cloud Migration, Integrations & Automation
Conduct complex Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud, Cloud to Cloud) including discovery, planning, testing, and cutover. Perform post-migration stabilization, assess marketplace apps and integrations for migration or replacement, and re-implement using REST APIs, webhooks, ScriptRunner, and plugins while coordinating functional validation.
Design and build automations and AI-assisted workflows using Automation for Jira, ScriptRunner, and AI capabilities (Atlassian Intelligence/Rovo, generative AI) to reduce manual effort across Jira administration, reporting, forecasting, and project delivery. Define responsible AI guardrails including data handling and output validation. Mentor peers on automation rule-building and safe AI use while staying current on Atlassian Cloud features and emerging technologies.

Description:
As a SAP EWM Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for SAP supply chain and operations applications. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and offer training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP supply chain and operations applications. Working in this area, you will enable clients to optimize their supply chain processes, improve operational efficiency, and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations. Upholding professional and technical standards, you will contribute to the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within our Tax practice.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement SAP supply chain and operations solutions effectively
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
- Optimizing supply chain processes to enhance operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
- Utilizing data-driven insights to inform supply chain transformation initiatives
- Managing project resources and budgeting to deliver successful client engagements
- Coordinating supply chain management activities to improve performance and reduce lead times
- Developing procurement strategies and implementing procurement systems to enhance cost efficiency
- Designing warehouse layouts and managing warehouse systems to streamline operations
- Applying analytical thinking to solve complex supply chain challenges and improve processes
- Collaborating with clients to build meaningful relationships and anticipate their needs
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Supply Chain and Operations solutions, including SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Transportation Management (TM), or related logistics credentials
- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Supply Chain Management (SAP SCM)
- Utilizing data-driven insights for supply chain optimization
- Managing complex supply chain transformation projects
- Excelling in demand forecasting and planning operations
- Leveraging analytical thinking for supply chain analysis
- Implementing procurement strategies and system improvements

Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Consultant
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 5+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..
Role Summary
Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions - underpinned by the world's largest delivery network - Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at

Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network - a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Description:
Project Role : Cloud Technical Architect

Project Role Description : Develop and deliver agile and cost effective hosting solutions. Implement scalable, high performance hosting solutions that meet the need of todays corporate and digital applications using both private and public cloud technologies. Plan and deliver legacy infrastructure transformation and migration to drive next-generation business outcomes.

Must have skills : SAP ABAP Development for HANA

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
As a Business Analyst with strong SAP ABAP on HANA with BRIM SOM exposure, a typical day involves analyzing organizational processes, systems, and subscription-based business models to understand how they function end-to-end. The role focuses on aligning business requirements with SAP BRIM Subscription Order Management (SOM) and HANA-based technical solutions. This includes identifying customer and stakeholder needs, envisioning future-state improvements across the subscription lifecycle, and supporting data-driven decision-making through effective requirement analysis and collaboration with technical teams to enhance overall business performance.
Roles Responsibilities
Expected to perform independently and grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in SAP ABAP on HANA and BRIM SOM.
Actively participate and contribute to team discussions, solution design, and problem-solving activities.
Provide effective solutions to work-related challenges, particularly in subscription order lifecycle, order changes, and integrations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional, technical, and business stakeholders) to ensure alignment between BRIM SOM processes and technology implementations.
Document and clearly communicate business and functional requirements to technical teams, ensuring accurate ABAP on HANA implementation.
Support and mentor junior team members by sharing knowledge and best practices in SAP ABAP, HANA, and BRIM SOM.
Continuously monitor and evaluate business and subscription processes to identify opportunities for optimization, automation, and innovation.
Professional Technical Skills
Must-Have Skills
Proficiency in SAP ABAP Development on HANA.
Hands-on experience in SAP BRIM Subscription Order Management (SOM) ABAP developments and enhancements.
Experience in developing and customizing SAP applications using ABAP for HANA environments, including performance-optimized coding.
Strong understanding of SAP HANA database concepts, CDS views, Open SQL, and performance tuning techniques.
Ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex technical and functional issues within SAP BRIM and core SAP systems.
Familiarity with integration of BRIM SOM with CI, FI-CA, Convergent Invoicing, and downstream systems.
Skilled in writing efficient, maintainable code while adhering to SAP development best practices.

Experience Qualifications
Minimum 8+ years of experience in SAP ABAP Development on HANA, with exposure to SAP BRIM SOM.
Position based at the Bangalore office.
15 years of full-time education is required.

Qualification 15 years full time education

Description:
Technology Strategy and Transformation Senior Manager Technology Modernization

Join our team in Technology Strategy Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future-ready technology landscapes

Practice: Technology Strategy Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Technology Modernization Strategy, Application Modernization
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 15+ years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growthAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choicesDo you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise-wide technology modernization strategies, target-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end-to-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:

Modernization Strategy Value Agenda: Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes Technology Estate Application Portfolio Assessment: Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio-level priorities Target Architecture Modernization Pathways: Shape target-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation Modernization Roadmap, Business Case Decision Governance: Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade-offs and realize measurable business value

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.

The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.

The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.

The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long-term architecture fit.

Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap


Lead enterprise-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes

Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business-aligned technology modernization priorities

Assess current-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems

Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools

Shape target-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction

Define modernization guiding principles, decision prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices

Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners

Build multi-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness

Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed-to-market


Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture Planning


Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential

Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities

Define application modernization pathways for target applications

Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options

Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies

Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity

Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API-led integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, cloud-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform-based modernization

Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future-ready application architecture

Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


Executive advisory and Growth


Lead CxO-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade-offs and enterprise transformation decisions

Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions

Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership-ready points of view

Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive-ready solution narratives

Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client

Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks

Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


Core Skillsets Tools

Technology Modernization Advisory


Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed-to-market and technology simplification

Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt

Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes

Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement

Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness



Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


Application Architecture, Engineering and AI


Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts

Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event-driven architecture, API-led integration, cloud-native application design and strangler-based modernization

Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity

Experience with aging application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end-of-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes

Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure-as-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering

Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment

Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI-ready application architecture

Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


Consulting and Communication Skills


Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling

Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams

Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities

Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


Whats in it for you


An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients

Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.

Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities

Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


Qualification

Your experience counts!


Bachelors degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus

15+ years of experience in technology consulting, technology strategy, application modernization, architecture-led transformation, cloud modernization or large-scale technology transformation advisory

Experience working with CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture, application, platform, cloud, data and business leadership teams to shape modernization strategies and transformation priorities

Hands on experience in defining and driving minimum 2 technology modernization engagement for a client with large IT landscape with expertise in defining portfolio prioritization according to minimal business continuity risk

Hands-on experience in defining modern application architecture patterns and practices

Experience with aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end-of-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes

Strong understanding of modernization pathways including the ability to evaluate trade-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity

Experience shaping target-state and transition architecture across application, integration, data, cloud and platform layers

Exposure to modern engineering, cloud, data and AI-enabled modernization concepts, including DevSecOps, CI/CD, platform engineering, cloud-native architecture, data modernization, GenAI enablement and AI-ready application architecture

Experience creating executive-ready deliverables such as modernization strategy documents, application portfolio heatmaps, architecture options, roadmap views, business cases, investment options and CxO-level presentations

Experience leading consulting teams, including structuring workplans, guiding analysis, reviewing deliverables, facilitating workshops and managing senior stakeholder discussions

Experience supporting proposal development, solution shaping, strategic pursuits, thought leadership or practice-building activities in technology modernization or adjacent transformation areas.

Understanding of at least one of the industries across Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Telecommunications, Resources, Industrial, Automotive, Travel or similar sectors is preferred

Strong facilitation capability with experience in workshops, design thinking sessions, leadership discussions and architecture governance forums

Role: Generative AI Engineer AWS
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

We are seeking a talented Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS Cloud and a strong Data Engineering background. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying GenAI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and scalable data pipelines. Experience in building enterprise-grade AI applications, working with cloud-native services, and processing large-scale datasets is highly preferred.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using AWS cloud services.
Build and optimize RAG-based solutions using enterprise data sources and vector databases.
Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to support AI and analytics workloads.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy LLMs and foundation models.
Integrate AI models with enterprise applications through REST APIs and microservices.
Process and manage structured and unstructured datasets for AI use cases.
Implement prompt engineering and model optimization techniques.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Monitor model performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Follow MLOps best practices for model deployment, versioning, governance, and monitoring.

Description:
Tech Transformation delivery leader- Associate Director
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale complex AI led Technology Transformation programmes for our most strategic clients across the globe. You will lead the execution of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that drive strategic business outcomes, operational excellence, and sustainable value creation across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Tech Transformation delivery leader
Level: Associate Director
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 17+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability:Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity.Revenue Management and Financial Governance:Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M-$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Integration and Dependency Management:Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level Global Delivery Leadership:Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership:Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings


Role Summary
As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.



Key Responsibilities

Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;


Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.


Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.


Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.


Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.


Accountability for the account P&L manage budgets of $5M-$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.


Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.


Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.


Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.


Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.


Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.


Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.


Qualification

What We're Looking For

17-20 years' total experience; 3-5 years proven experience managing and delivering complex portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M.


Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.


Demonstrated track record of C-suite stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.


Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.


Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.


Strong executive presence:communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.


Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernization, Mainframe Modernisation, AI Enterprise Transformation, Complex Delivery, Enterprise Agility

Set yourself apart:
Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programmes leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient





Qualifications & Certifications

Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); Master's / MBA strongly preferred.


PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.


SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.


Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) - advantageous.

What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.

Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Explore An Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth.
As a part of this high performing team, you will proactively and holistically help and guide the enterprise leaders, product managers, product owners and distributed product delivery teams through transformation and optimization initiatives, supporting the formulation of business strategy, outcomes and capabilities. Your scope of activities could include helping the organization achieve targeted business outcomes related to growing revenue, optimizing costs, mitigating risks and improving sustainability. You focus on development of the business and IT strategy and enterprise architecture of the organization as a whole.
You would be expected to:
Facilitate alignment between business and IT, and across the democratized IT landscape
Engage business and IT stakeholders, building and maintaining relationships
Adapt to changing business and operating models
Analyze trends and disruptions, and assess their impact on targeted business outcomes
Tell stories to visualize the future state and trigger long-term planning
Support various operating models such as project-centric and product-centric
Communicate the value of enterprise architecture, and its portfolio of services
Drive the evolution of the EA teams services and operating model
Coach and mentor other architects, product owners/managers and business stakeholders to instill architectural thinking

As an Technology Strategy & Advisory leader, you will demonstrate competencies across four key dimensions:
Support Formulation of Strategy and Guide Execution
Work with business and leadership stakeholders to develop strategy
Lead the analysis of business and operating models, market trends and the technology industry to determine their potential impact on the enterprises business strategy, direction, and architecture.
Provide perspective on the readiness of the organization to change and innovate through scenario planning techniques, and supports formulation of business strategy.
Uses planning-driven, design-driven and learning-driven approaches to construct future- and current-state business models.
Connects Strategy to Execution
Facilitate business and IT alignment, connecting strategy to execution, through a collaborative, supportive and consultative manner, driving the organizations digital business strategies and balancing innovation and growth.
Translate and guide execution of business strategy to achieve the organizations targeted business outcomes.
Construct technology-enabled business and operating models and provides viable options and visibility into execution issues.
Build and Maintain Relationships
Build the Technology value proposition and structure business engagement
Build the Tech value proposition, offering services and skills to support the development and execution of business strategy.
Develop a portfolio of consulting services, designed to meet business and stakeholder needs, and delivers in an agile and time-boxed way.
Determine the relationship between people, processes, information, technology and other components of the enterprise operating model.
Enable value-based messaging and manage cross-functional relationships
Provide consultative advice, adapted to stakeholder context, to business leaders and organizational stakeholders who seek actionable recommendations to make investment decisions about the next business and operating model of their organization, using technology to make that change happen.

Lead - Business Development

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.

Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Virtual Engagement Solutions (Remote Sales) is focused on expanding customer reach, increasing engagement with existing and prospective accounts, and driving commercial growth through remote customer interactions. VES partners with sales leaders across multiple Medtronic Operating Units to identify opportunities, support market development initiatives, and improve access to Medtronic therapies through a scalable virtual engagement model.
This role leads remote sales activities across the North, East, and West regions of India, supporting a broad portfolio of businesses and customer segments. The position is preferably based in Gurugram, with Mumbai also considered, and operates in a primarily office-based environment where virtual engagement is the primary mode of customer and stakeholder interaction. Travel is expected up to 25% for business reviews, team engagement activities, customer meetings, and key stakeholder interactions.
The Remote Sales Supervisor will lead the expansion and execution of the Virtual Engagement Solutions (VES) model across North, East, and West India. This role combines people leadership, strategic account management, pipeline oversight, business development, and cross-functional collaboration to drive commercial growth through remote sales channels. The position is responsible for building team capability, supporting market expansion, and delivering commercial objectives across multiple Operating Units.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of 6-7 remote sales representatives to deliver annual operating plan objectives across assigned regions.
Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, driving engagement, opportunity development, and commercial outcomes through virtual interactions.
Partner with commercial leaders and stakeholders across multiple Operating Units to identify growth opportunities and execute market development initiatives.
Expand Medtronic's presence within new and underserved accounts through targeted remote engagement strategies and customer outreach programmes.
Monitor sales pipelines, account targeting activities, opportunity progression, forecasting, and reporting to maximise commercial performance.
Coach and develop direct reports through performance management, capability building, and sales effectiveness initiatives.
Analyse sales performance data, market trends, and customer insights to identify opportunities for revenue growth, market share expansion, and process improvement.
Lead planning, coordination, reporting, and implementation of VES projects and operational initiatives across supported businesses.

Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of team management, product marketing, sales leadership, or commercial management experience.

Preferred:
Experience within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or related healthcare industry.
Experience managing inside sales, remote sales, contact centre, virtual sales, or customer engagement teams.
3+ years of people management experience leading, coaching, and developing teams of 6-7 or more direct reports.
Experience supporting multiple business units, product portfolios, or matrixed commercial organisations.
Knowledge of account development, market expansion, customer engagement strategies, and data-driven sales performance management across diverse geographic regions.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Description:
We are looking for a seasoned Informatica MDM SaaS Manager to lead and manage our Informatica Master Data Management SaaS team, driving the development, implementation, and support of scalable MDM solutions aligned with enterprise data governance and business objectives.
The role requires strong leadership skills to oversee large-scale SaaS MDM projects, ensuring best practices, data quality, and regulatory compliance.
You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to prioritize initiatives, manage resources, and deliver high-quality MDM services.
A strategic mindset combined with hands-on expertise in Informatica MDM SaaS principles, project management, and cross-functional team leadership is essential to succeed in this position.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the SaaS MDM team responsible for development, implementation, and support of MDM solutions.
Develop, execute, and maintain the overall Informatica MDM SaaS strategy aligned with enterprise data governance and business requirements.
Oversee the design and delivery of scalable SaaS MDM solutions, including data modeling, matching, survivorship, and workflows.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data stewards, and IT teams to prioritize SaaS MDM initiatives and ensure alignment with business goals.
Manage project timelines, resources, budgets, and vendor relationships related to Informatica SaaS MDM implementations.
Establish and enforce MDM best practices, data standards, and compliance with relevant data privacy laws and regulations.
Ensure robust data quality monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement processes are in place.
Drive cross-functional collaboration between MDM, data governance, data quality, and BI teams.
Manage release cycles, deployments, and upgrades of Informatica SaaS MDM platforms.
Provide leadership, mentoring, and career development guidance to team members.
Report regularly on MDM program status, risks, and performance metrics to senior leadership.
Stay current with MDM industry trends, tools, and technologies, and recommend innovations to enhance the MDM program.
Exposure to Advanced Match & Merge features such as Adaptive AI Matching, Match explainability & Tuning, Automated DQ Rule recommendations , Enrichment Orchestrator (EVO) Automated Reltationship Inference using CLAIRE

Required Qualifications:
Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
9-14 years of experience in Master Data Management, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role.
Strong experience managing large-scale Informatica MDM implementations (on-premises and/or cloud) preferrably cloud
Deep understanding of MDM principles including data modeling, survivorship rules, matching and linking algorithms, and data governance.
Proven ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams consisting of architects, developers, analysts, and QA professionals.
Solid project and resource management skills, including Agile and waterfall methodologies.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working closely with business and IT leadership.
Familiarity with related Informatica tools (CDGC, CDQ, CAI,IICS) and integration technologies.
Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and tactical mindset.
Experience with regulatory compliance related to data privacy (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a skilled and experienced AWS Gen AI Engineer to design and develop generative AI applications leveraging Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and SageMaker.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building GenAI applications using Bedrock foundation models, RAG pipelines with Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and prompt engineering workflows with Bedrock Guardrails.

Design and develop generative AI applications using Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and foundation models.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Bedrock Knowledge Bases with agentic retrieval, smart parsing, and multi-modal content support.
Develop custom ML models using SageMaker (training, fine-tuning, and deployment via JumpStart and HyperPod).
Implement prompt engineering, optimization, and fine-tuning workflows; leverage Intelligent Prompt Routing for cost optimization.
Configure and manage Bedrock Guardrails for content safety, PII filtering, and hallucination mitigation with Automated Reasoning checks.
Design data ingestion pipelines connecting enterprise sources (S3, SharePoint, Confluence, Google Drive, OneDrive, Web Crawler) to Knowledge Bases.
Conduct model evaluation, benchmarking, and A/B testing across foundation models.
Integrate GenAI capabilities into production applications using orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Strands Agents).
Provide technical guidance to associates on AI/ML best practices.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or related field.
5+ years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering.
3+ years of hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services.
Strong proficiency in building GenAI applications using Amazon Bedrock and foundation models.
Hands-on experience with SageMaker for model training, fine-tuning, and deployment (JumpStart, HyperPod).
Experience building RAG pipelines with Bedrock Knowledge Bases and vector stores (OpenSearch Serverless, Pinecone, or similar).
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).
Experience with orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or Strands Agents).
Experience with prompt engineering, optimization, and evaluation techniques.
Understanding of LLM architectures, tokenization, and inference optimization.
Experience configuring Bedrock Guardrails for content safety and compliance.
Knowledge of data engineering for AI/ML (ETL, data preprocessing, feature engineering).
Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical decisions.
Nice to Have
AWS Machine Learning Specialty or AI Practitioner certification.
Experience with multi-modal AI (vision, audio, text) on Bedrock.
Familiarity with model monitoring, SageMaker MLOps pipelines, and AI observability.
Experience with AI tools in development lifecycles (GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, Amazon Q Developer).
Knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, Automated Reasoning, and bias mitigation.

Product Owner Administration

Customers / Stakeholders

Leadership & Teamwork

Provide assurance that any process risks identified are highlighted and managed as appropriate
Support all regulatory and compliance matters and the management of operational risk

Major Challenges
Be able to cover a wide range of financial matters and products from accounting perspective
Partner with the Finance teams to achieve a strong and accurate maintenance of the Avaloq Chart of Account

Management of Risk
Ensure all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring
Addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department

Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators

Knowledge of IFRSs and awareness of banking/finance concepts

Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team

Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence
Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

What additional skills will be good to have?
Knowledge of FTP Chart of Account, GRCA and FTP Global mappings
