Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.
Develop teaching and learning materials focused on Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) for different grades or contexts.
Design and facilitate online and in-person training and capacity-building sessions for enumerators, teachers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct refresher training and follow-up learning circles to reinforce capacity building and improve delivery quality.
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree in Education, Social Science, or a related field.
Experience
1-2 years of proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, or program implementation.
Prior experience in on-ground or field-based roles is preferred.
Exposure to training facilitation, monitoring, or stakeholder coordination will be an advantage.
Understanding of Social Emotional Learning (SEL), mental health, or child psychology is preferred.
Characteristics
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Bengali (non-negotiable).
Knowledge of other regional dialects in Tripura will be preferred.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and coordination skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Proficient in Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfortable with digital reporting systems.
Highly motivated, empathetic, and driven by childrens wellbeing.
A self-starter who acts with urgency, takes initiative, and learns quickly.
Comfortable with regular travel across districts for field visits, training, and coordination.
Open to experimentation, collaboration, and feedback in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.
Deeply committed to integrity, transparency, and trust in both process and relationships.
If youre someone who is driven by purpose, excited to build, and energized by working closely with communities in service of childrens wellbeing, wed love to hear from you. We care more about your drive, alignment, and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

Location: Tripura

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Head to lead and expand our sales operations in Tripura. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in the sales of Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
The candidate should have excellent knowledge of the Tripura market, strong dealer and distributor networks, and the ability to achieve sales targets through effective market development and channel management.

Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Lead and manage sales activities across the Tripura market.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, retailers, and customers.

Manage and strengthen existing dealer and distributor networks.
Conduct regular market visits and identify business opportunities.
Drive sales of Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler/Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Generate new business opportunities.
Negotiate pricing, orders, schemes, and commercial terms.
Monitor sales performance against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, dispatches, payments, and customer support.
Prepare regular sales reports and market updates.
Monitor competitor pricing, products, schemes, and activities.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.
Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Channel Sales.
Relevant experience in Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Strong dealer and distributor handling experience.
Proven track record of target-based sales.
Strong understanding of the Tripura market.
Required Skills
Communication and negotiation skills.
Market development and channel management.
Dealer/distributor/retailer handling.
Leadership and team-management skills.
Business development and revenue-generation skills.
Strong networking and relationship-management abilities.
Willingness to travel extensively.
Ability to work in a target-oriented environment.
Compensation
5 LPA to 50 LPA, depending on experience, market exposure, existing dealer/distributor network, industry knowledge, and sales performance.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates who have a strong existing network of dealers and distributors in Tripura and relevant industry experience will be highly preferred.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution

Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Description:
Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.
Assist in maintaining compliance with all pharmaceutical storage and distribution guidelines.
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.
Experience:
Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience for D. Pharma holders.
Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.

LRS services is an integrated and innovative technology firm providing managed IT services, maintenance services, staffing services and hardware support globally. Offering customized service solutions and hardware that help customers to reduce overall costs and minimize risk in all phases of their IT life cycle.

Description:
Director / Manager Business Development and Customer Success
Tripura Multinational was started to tap into the vast unaddressed opportunities in Leadership Capability Transformation within businesses operating in Asia Pacific, Japan, India and the Middle East. With the business environment changing at a rapid pace, and customer expectations rising significantly, it is incumbent on every organization to build the next generation of skills and capabilities within their teams, and to empower their managers to amplify the impact of those skills through the power of coaching.
We are looking for an individual with a passion for Selling, Sales Management and Customer Success. If you have experience selling People and Capability Transformation solutions to Global Business and Human Resource Leaders, then this job is for you.
Responsibilities
Lead by example on the quality of your customer engagement that our Sales and Leadership Programs seek to exemplify.
You would ideally be proactive with an internal drive for excellence and an external orientation for customer centricity and success.
You would play a strategic role in expanding the client/customer base. You would actively prospect, position, qualify leads, close the deal and sell the gamut of our program offerings.
You would independently build a territory plan segmenting your markets and focusing your execution.
Manage and build the CRM for your territory with discipline, consistency and commitment. Daily updates are encouraged.
Develop and deliver a yearly/quarterly plan linked to sales performance management with measurable KPIs for pipeline progression and conversion.
Possess the gravitas to drive 2-3 CXO meetings every week.
Draft proposals with measurable and monetizable business value that will aid acceleration in your sales cycle.
Maintain good relationships with all existing and prospective clients and collaborate internally with teams like Marketing, Finance and Operations.
Identify market trends and customer requirements that brings insights and foresights back into the business.
Qualifications
You ideally possess 10-15 years of experience in Business Development with comprehensive knowledge and experience working in B2B businesses, preferably selling professional services.
You have engaged in end-to-end sales cycle progression as an independent contributor performing both hunting roles for new customer acquisition and farming roles for cross-selling/up-selling to an existing customer.
You are familiar with CRM systems and can showcase field discipline by gleaning insights from the CRM.
You have excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to differentiate yourself through the quality of your articulation and engagement.
You are driven by Innovation and champion bold ideas and new ways of doing things for your customer. You ask challenging and stretching questions which are themselves value for the customer.
Any exposure to training, education, skill development, assessment, human capability development and coaching within organizations would be your additional asset in this role.
This role will report to the Director for Sales Effectiveness and Execution Excellence and will be based in India / Singapore. In Singapore, Singaporeans and Permanent Residents of Singapore will be accorded priority for hire. Others can apply too.

Job Description

Architect solutions using AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or GCP services.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Description:
Business Information:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energys units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement:
Service Sales & Tendering Team Manager is responsible for leading the Service Sales and Tendering team to deliver high-quality, timely and competitive offers for service business opportunities. The role includes managing team operations, resource allocation, competence development, stakeholder collaboration and people development. This position drives standardization, best-practice sharing, continuous improvement and team capability development while supporting business growth, customer satisfaction and operational excellence across global and local service sales requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
Team Leadership and People Development
Lead, coach and mentor the Service Sales and Tendering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
Conduct regular performance and development discussions, define individual goals, identify competency gaps and support career growth.
Build team capability through structured onboarding, training, knowledge sharing and development of behavioral and functional competencies.
Drive recruitment, onboarding and resource readiness to support business expansion and future scope growth.
Promote diversity, inclusion, positive team dynamics and a healthy work environment.
Service Sales and Tendering Operations
Manage end-to-end service sales and tendering activities, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, timelines, quality standards and business expectations.
Oversee RFQ review, scope clarification, technical-commercial alignment, offer preparation, risk assessment, bid submission and post-offer support.
Provide guidance on tendering process flow, commercial governance, risk identification and quality of offer submissions.
Support scope addition, team scaling and long-term capability building to match evolving business needs.
Stakeholder and Business Collaboration
Collaborate with global stakeholders, sales units, factories, HUBs, customers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide updates and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain regular engagement with business counterparts to align priorities, review performance and address operational challenges.
Performance Management and Operational Excellence
Drive and monitor key performance indicators such as On-Time Delivery, Hit rate, efficiency, utilization, NPS/customer satisfaction and quality of deliverables.
Ensure effective workload planning, prioritization of critical cases and visibility of long-pending offers or execution gaps.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, best-practice deployment and quality management system adherence.
Develop and maintain a roadmap for team growth, productivity improvement, competency development and future technology/tool adoption.
Administrative and Financial Responsibilities
Manage team administration, including resource planning, leave planning, onboarding support, infrastructure coordination and HR-related operational support.
Support business-related financial coordination such as offer submission tracking, purchase order follow-up, invoicing coordination and payment collection follow-up where applicable.
Ensure accurate reporting, timely updates and effective governance of team deliverables and business support activities.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
Education
Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
Electrical Engineering or power/energy sector background will be an added advantage.
Experience
10+ years of experience in Sales, Tendering, Front-End Sales, EPC or related functions.
Prior experience in managing teams, working with global stakeholders and supporting multi-location or global business environments will be preferred.
Experience in HV switchgear, Transformer, substations or service business.
Functional Skills
Strong knowledge of service sales, tendering process flow, commercial review, risk assessment and offer management.
Ability to manage sales processes, stakeholder requirements, timelines, quality standards and business priorities.
Working knowledge of CRM/Salesforce and Power BI will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, organizational and risk management skills.
Leadership and Behavioral Skills
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management and team-building abilities.
Strong interpersonal skills to manage team dynamics, resolve conflicts and maintain a positive work environment.
Strategic thinking with a proactive approach to business growth, scalability and capability development.

We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.

Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.

Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.

Location : Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai (Hybrid / Work from Office as per project requirement)

We are looking for a highly experienced Enterprise AI Architect who can drive the design and implementation of AI/GenAI solutions across large-scale enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should have experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise business platforms such as:
SAP (S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP AI Core)

Stakeholder Management

AI Center of Excellence leadership
What We Are Looking For
Candidates who have successfully implemented:
AI + SAP
AI + Oracle
AI + Salesforce
AI + ServiceNow
AI + PEGA
rather than profiles that are purely focused on standalone GenAI, Data Science, or AI research.
Summary -
"We are looking for a Senior Enterprise AI Architect who has implemented GenAI/Agentic AI solutions on top of enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, PEGA. The role is focused on enterprise transformation, AI integration, and business process automation rather than standalone AI development."
Detailed Job Description
Position Overview
Tech Mahindra is hiring Senior AI Architects across Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and Bangalore. This role is for senior technology leaders who can define AI architecture strategy, design enterprise-grade solutions, and guide teams from concept to production at scale.
The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on architecture and implementation leadership. It is suited to professionals who can connect business priorities, enterprise platforms, cloud ecosystems, and AI engineering practices into scalable and reusable solution patterns.
Role Purpose
The Senior AI Architect will shape and validate AI-led transformation programs for enterprise clients, with a strong focus on scalable architecture, reusable assets, and outcome-driven solution design. The role is expected to bridge business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, data and AI engineering teams, and delivery leadership across global engagements.
This role requires practical judgment on how AI should be embedded into enterprise landscapes, including business applications, integration layers, governance controls, and production operations. Strong communication with CXOs and cross-functional stakeholders is central to success in this role.
Key Responsibilities
Define target-state AI and data architecture aligned to business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, and transformation roadmaps.
Design end-to-end AI solution architectures covering data pipelines, model development, deployment, monitoring, security, and integration with enterprise applications.
Build scalable and reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, and patterns for enterprise AI adoption.
Evaluate and validate solution options across cloud, AI, and enterprise application platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Lead architecture reviews, technical due diligence, feasibility studies, and proof-of-concept direction for AI initiatives.
Collaborate with business leaders, delivery teams, product owners, security teams, and global stakeholders to shape credible and implementable solutions.
Establish good practices for testing, deployment, observability, lifecycle management, and production support of AI systems.
Drive architectural governance across responsible AI, compliance, privacy, model risk, and enterprise security requirements.
Mentor engineering and architecture teams, influence critical technology choices, and support executive-level solution positioning.
Required Experience
12+ years of overall experience in enterprise technology, architecture, or digital transformation, with strong recent experience in AI/ML solution architecture and delivery.
Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI or ML solutions for enterprise use cases.
Experience across more than one enterprise platform, preferably SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or adjacent enterprise ecosystems.
Experience working in architecture consulting, transformation programs, or complex enterprise modernization engagements.
Demonstrated ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, and multidisciplinary global teams to influence architectural decisions.
Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architecture, security, scalability, and non-functional design principles.
AI And Technical Skills
AI Architecture
End-to-end AI/ML architecture, including data ingestion, feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience with generative AI architecture, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt orchestration, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.
Ability to define reference patterns for recommendation, forecasting, NLP, computer vision, intelligent automation, and enterprise copilots.
Cloud And MLOps
Strong architecture experience on one or more cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Working knowledge of enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices such as experiment tracking, model registry, pipeline orchestration, deployment automation, and model monitoring.
Experience with tools and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow, or equivalent ecosystems.
AI Engineering Stack
Hands-on familiarity with Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools used in enterprise AI delivery.
Understanding of vector databases, knowledge retrieval patterns, API orchestration, agent frameworks, and model integration approaches for production AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services with enterprise applications, data platforms, and middleware layers using secure and scalable design patterns.
Enterprise Platform Expectations
Candidates should bring hands-on architecture or implementation exposure across at least two enterprise platforms or transformation ecosystems. Preferred experience includes SAP BTP or SAP AI capabilities, Oracle enterprise applications and data services, ServiceNow workflow and automation platforms, Salesforce ecosystem integrations, and broader enterprise application modernization patterns.
The role values professionals who can embed AI into enterprise process landscapes rather than treating AI as a standalone lab initiative. Strong grounding in business process transformation, platform interoperability, and enterprise-scale rollout models is important for success.
Leadership And Consulting Skills
Executive presence and the ability to articulate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks, and value realization clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong consulting mindset with structured problem solving, solution framing, estimation support, and transformation roadmap definition.
Ability to lead cross-functional workshops, align distributed teams, and drive decisions in complex, fast-moving programs.
Practical, solution-oriented approach with the confidence to challenge weak designs and strengthen architecture quality before implementation.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required. A master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Preferred Certifications
AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certifications.
AI/ML specialty certifications on major cloud platforms.
Enterprise architecture or platform certifications across SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or related ecosystems.

Hyderabad | Chennai | Pune | Bangalore

Company Profile:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
Job Title: RTM Development
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Experience: 5-9yrs
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: General
Main location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
Position Description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer with strong expertise in C and C++ development. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in object-oriented programming, data structures, and analytical problem-solving. This role requires the ability to work independently, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and deliver high-quality software solutions in a dynamic development environment.
Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications using C and C++.
Analyze business and technical requirements and implement efficient software solutions.
Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code following coding standards and best practices.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance issues.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and knowledge sharing.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Independently own assigned tasks and deliver them within committed timelines.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes and software quality.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years of hands-on software development experience using C and C++.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
Solid knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Willingness to work in shifts (12:00 PM to 9:30 PM).
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with debugging and performance optimization.
Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Knowledge of version control systems such as Git.
Experience with code review and software quality best practices.
Exposure to Linux/Unix development environments.
Understanding of multithreading and concurrent programming concepts.
CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
Life at CGI:
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons
Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

Technology Strategy and Transformation Senior Manager AI driven SDLC strategy

Join our team in Technology Strategy Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering

Practice: Technology Strategy Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: AI Native SDLC Strategy, Agentic AI Architecture, Agentic Software Engineering, Engineering Productivity, AI Platform Tooling Strategy
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 10-15 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native eraAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AIAre you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Software Engineering Transformation and AI-led Reinvention, where you will work with key global clients to shape the next evolution of enterprise software delivery. As part of this high-performing team, you will help organizations move from experimentation with AI coding tools to enterprise-wide AI Native SDLC transformation. These are some of the initiatives you will support:

AI Native SDLC Strategy and Roadmap: Assess current SDLC maturity, AI readiness, engineering productivity, application landscape assessment for AI driven delivery, toolchain landscape and delivery bottlenecks; define target-state AI Native SDLC vision and pragmatic adoption roadmap Engineering Productivity and AI Readiness Diagnosis: Diagnose developer experience, flow of work, quality gates, release throughput, automation levels, technology debt, test coverage, knowledge fragmentation and value leakage across large engineering organizations Use Case Identification and Prioritization: Identify and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review, security, release, documentation and run/operate interfaces; segment applications and teams where adoption makes business and technology sense AI Native SDLC Platform and Tooling Strategy Architecture: Define architecture principles, reference architecture and tooling strategy across IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, knowledge systems, model gateways, context layer, RAG, agent orchestration, MCP, observability and governance Value Case and Benefits Framework: Define productivity, velocity, quality, cost, risk and developer experience outcomes; establish measurement model, value case, benefits tracking and AI cost governance Delivery Operating Model and Change: Design target-state engineering operating model considering AI native software delivery and help organization transition to new operating model Executive Advisory and Scale Strategy: Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps, investment choices, vendor strategy and scale-up plan for enterprise-wide AI Native SDLC adoption

Role Overview

We are looking for a visionary leader in Technology Strategy and Software Engineering Transformation who can help enterprises redefine how software is delivered in an AI-native world. The role requires a senior consulting practitioner with strong understanding of enterprise SDLC, AI/ GenAI and Agentic architecture, engineering productivity, Agile, CI/CD and DevSecOps.

The successful candidate will lead strategic advisory work across the AI Native SDLC transformation journey from current-state maturity and AI readiness assessment to target-state SDLC design, AI use case prioritization, platform and tooling strategy, value case development, benefits framework, roadmap definition and operating model change.

The role requires executive presence, strong consulting capability and the ability to independently engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, engineering leaders and product/platform teams. The candidate should be able to shape compelling transformation narratives, facilitate senior stakeholder alignment and translate AI-powered software delivery ambition into practical, business-aligned decisions and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

AI Native SDLC Strategy and Advisory


Lead current-state SDLC maturity, AI readiness and engineering productivity assessments across large engineering organizations

Define target-state AI Native SDLC ambition and strategy across all stages of fotware delivery and software maintenance

Conduct application landscape assessment to Identify applications, products and teams best suited for AI-native and agentic SDLC adoption based on value, feasibility, risk and readiness

Identify, structure and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across the software delivery lifecycle, linking them to engineering productivity, quality and measurable outcomes

Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment on the adoption priorities, transformation choices and approach


Target-State SDLC Design, Architecture and Tooling Strategy


Design AI-Native delivery workflows and agentic patterns across all stages of SDLC

Define AI Native SDLC platform reference architecture across ALM, IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, observability, knowledge systems, model gateways, RAG/context layer, MCP/tool interfaces and guardrails with responsible AI frameworks pre-built in the design

Advise clients on AI platform, toolchain and vendor strategy, including integration approach, security, data/IP considerations, cost and developer adoption

Define architecture principles, reusable patterns, guardrails, governance constructs and agentic evaluation criteria required to scale AI-Native engineering responsibly

Work with architecture, platform, security and engineering teams to connect strategy with implementation realities while maintaining an advisory and transformation-planning focus


Value Realization, Productivity Measurement and Engineering Operating Model


Build AI Native SDLC value cases covering various dimensions across productivity, quality, risk, experience and cost

Define benefits framework and productivity measurement approach using baselines, KPIs, telemetry, DORA, SPACE, flow metrics, adoption metrics and executive reporting

Define AI value economics and cost governance across licensing, token consumption, model usage, chargeback/showback, cost guardrails and benefit realization

Design target engineering operating model covering product/platform ownership, AI SDLC center of excellence, roles and responsibilities, governance forums, enablement and change adoption

Translate target-state architecture and operating model into a phased transformation roadmap covering quick wins, foundational enablers, pilots, scaling waves and governance milestones


Executive Advisory and Market Development


Lead CxO-level conversations on AI Native SDLC strategy, engineering productivity, platform choices, tooling strategy, value realization, governance and operating model change

Create expert content, PoVs and use executive storytelling, presentation and communication skills for C-level discussions

Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated advisory propositions, points of view, solution narratives and proposal leadership.

Collaborate across different capabilities and teams to shape holistic client solutions and connect AI Native SDLC transformation with broader enterprise reinvention priorities

Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks

Lead and mentor teams on AI, modern engineering, software delivery and engineering productivity measures


Core Skillsets Tools

Enterprise Software Engineering and SDLC


Strong understanding of enterprise software delivery, including Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, test automation, secure SDLC, release management, platform engineering and SRE concepts.

Ability to assess SDLC maturity, engineering practices, delivery bottlenecks, toolchains, governance and productivity across large, distributed engineering organizations.

Strong understanding of engineering productivity, developer experience, software quality, technical debt, application complexity and delivery value streams.

Ability to design future-state SDLC processes, governance models and transformation roadmaps aligned to business and engineering outcomes.

Application Architecture, Engineering and AI


AI / Agentic Fluency, Tools and Platform Capabilities


Strong understanding of GenAI, LLMs and agentic software engineering concepts, including prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, MCP, guardrails and evaluations

Practical understanding of AI-assisted SDLC use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, coding, code review, refactoring, testing, security, documentation, release support and operations handover

Familiarity with leading AI coding and SDLC tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitLab Duo, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, Sourcegraph Cody, Atlassian Rovo or equivalent tools

Familiarity with AI platforms and agentic orchestration tools such as Microsoft/Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen/CrewAI, LangSmith/MLflow or equivalent platforms.

Understanding of enterprise context and knowledge architectures using code indexing, embeddings, vector databases, enterprise search, knowledge graphs, RAG and model ecosystems including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama and open-source models.

Ability to define toolchain architecture, vendor evaluation criteria, integration patterns, pilot approach, rollout considerations and governance required for scalable AI Native SDLC adoption.


Value, Economics and Productivity Measurement


Ability to formulate AI Native SDLC value cases across productivity, cycle time, quality, risk, cost, developer experience and business agility outcomes

Ability to connect AI adoption choices to measurable business outcomes and executive-level investment decisions


Consulting and Communication Skills


Strong consulting toolkit across structured problem solving, hypothesis-led analysis, benchmarking, assessment design, facilitation, executive storytelling, business case development and roadmap definition

Ability to drive CxO-level conversations with credibility, influence senior stakeholders and align business, engineering, architecture, security, finance and technology teams

Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits, senior client relationships and high-performing consulting teams


Qualification

Your experience counts!

10+ years of experience in consulting, technology strategy, software engineering transformation, engineering productivity and AI/GenAI advisory in software delivery

Description:
Encourage collaboration and proactively contribute to team discussions
Apply critical thinking to complex procurement challenges and strategic decision-making
Leverage data and industry trends to extract insights for S2P strategy
Provide clear and structured communication to stakeholders and suppliers
Maintain adaptability in working across various business environments and supply chain models
Uphold PwCs commitment to ethics and business conduct
Additional Responsibilities
Team and Client Management
Lead procurement project delivery and ensure execution against KPIs
Act as a key liaison between stakeholders, suppliers, and procurement teams
Provide insights and recommendations for process efficiencies and procurement modernization
Lead client discussions and drive influence through actionable insights
S2P Transformation
Experience with Coupa - Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platform, as an implementer and administrator; ERP knowledge – SAP / PeopleSoft / ORACLE or others is preferred
Understanding of fundamental principles of Coupa including spend and commodity taxonomies, requisitioning, PO generation, receiving and invoice processing
Experience with AP automation including eInvoicing, scanning and workflow, online tracking, reporting capabilities, electronic invoice user interfaces, supplier networks, etc.
Ability to design the approval work flows in Coupa transactional documents like PO’s, Service Confirmations and Invoices
Ability to configure, develop, and troubleshoot RESTful APIs and flat file-based integrations for all master and transactional data between P2P platforms and backend systems
Ability to work with middleware tools Like Dell Boomi, Mulesoft, Snaplogic etc. to implement middleware logic as part of the integrations between Coupa & ERP system
Ability to develop solutions for clients using service-oriented architecture patterns to ensure master and transactional data are traveling successfully between systems
Ability to gather technical requirements and conduct sessions to design the integrations between P2P platforms and backend systems
Ability to take responsibility for all technical phases of an implementation project including architecture, design, development, test, customization, documentation and data migration solutions for business applications in the SaaS and other ERP systems
Ability to estimate the tasks and resources required to design, build, and test the integration design
Ability to design technical logic for solution development/enhancement
Ability to work with clients during the hypercare phase to resolve integration issues between Coupa and end-to-end systems
Ability to provide expert advice to clients on integration API and flat file best practices and deliver efficient and simple integration design for easy maintenance of system post Go-Live
Skillsets Preferred
Intermediate skills in developing integrations with Web Services, XML, JSON, SQL and or other integration technologies
Hands-on experience facilitating application integration architecture discussions and workshops
Proven experience in developing integrations using REST API, SOAP Web Services and other integration architectures.
Hands-on experience working with middleware platforms such as Dell Boomi, Mulesoft, Snaplogic etc.
Proven skills as a team member, team lead or project manager on at least three full life cycle implementations
Functional knowledge of Procurement business processes
Technical aptitude and comfort in understanding Web-based applications and the SaaS, PaaS and IaaS Cloud models, and Integration concepts as well as application of these technologies in the enterprise environment
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent preferred. Full-time master’s degree/equivalent is a bonus.
Active Coupa platform certification; Additional specialization certifications would be a bonus
2-4+ years of experience in procurement, category management, or sourcing strategy
Strong expertise in strategic sourcing, procurement analytics, and supplier management
Demonstrated ability to lead negotiations, influence stakeholders, and drive cost savings

Description:
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling expert with hands-on solution design, configuration, testing and deployment experience; preferably with an accounts/finance and cost/management accounting background.
Strong, demonstrable expertise in CO sub-modules: CO-CCA (Cost Center Accounting), CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting), CO-PC (Product Costing) product cost planning, standard cost estimates, cost estimate with/without quantity structure, mixed costing, variance analysis, WIP calculation, and settlement — Material Ledger (ML) and Actual Costing — multi-level actual costing run, periodic unit price, alternative valuation runs, parallel currencies/valuations — along with Profitability Analysis (CO-PA — costing-based and/or account-based), Internal Orders, and Overhead Cost Controlling, alongside FI-GL, FI-AR, FI-AP, Asset Accounting and ICMR.
Proven, hands-on experience configuring Controlling building blocks end-to-end: cost element/cost center hierarchies, activity types and planning, allocation cycles (assessment/distribution), costing sheets, cost component structures, Material Ledger activation and actual costing configuration, and profitability reporting structures.
Full lifecycle exposure to Product Costing and Material Ledger solutions — from requirement gathering and design (blueprinting/fit-gap), through configuration, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover, and post-go-live deployment support.
Ability to mentor and manage multiple teams and projects, with CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design ownership across workstreams.
Participate in design discussions, providing deep expertise on SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling capabilities (e.g., universal journal-based CO-FI real-time integration, margin analysis, Material Ledger as the valuation backbone in S/4HANA).
Work with business/controlling users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions for cost allocation, product costing, inventory valuation, and profitability reporting.
Develop a collaborative, cohesive team culture with a “One Team” mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance, Controlling and management accounting processes, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop, configure and test integrations between CO/Product Costing/Material Ledger and other modules — MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly cost flows from procurement, production, and project systems into Controlling and inventory valuation objects.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable real-time transactional-level matching.
Understanding of AIF, field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Hands-on experience in S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR), backed by a solid accounting, finance, and controlling background.
Demonstrated functional experience in Intercompany Reconciliation processes in SAP.
Knowledge and experience implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.
Preferred Knowledge
Hands-on, configuration-level knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling, including Product Costing and Material Ledger, other integration workstreams, CFIN, and ICMR, with the ability to drive projects through full design-configure-test-deploy cycles.
Understanding of different project delivery methodologies, especially Agile and Scrum frameworks, applied to CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design and testing cycles.
Preferred Skill
Hands-on configuration and design experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with demonstrable depth in Controlling (CO), Product Costing, and Material Ledger design, configuration and testing.
Familiarity with onsite/offshore delivery models and hands-on experience across system landscape environments (e.g., Dev/QA/Prod, transport management for CO/Product Costing/ML configuration).
Familiarity with Implementation, Support, Rollout, and Training delivery models — including testing phases specific to Product Costing and Material Ledger (cost estimate testing, actual costing run validation, integration testing across MM/SD/PP, UAT, and cutover/deployment support).
Familiarity with role matrix/role testing and ability to assist technical team members on CO/Product Costing/ML-related developments (reports, BAdIs, enhancements).
Familiarity with both Waterfall and Agile approaches to software/configuration delivery.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ownership and commitment, flexible timings.
Expertise in JIRA and Agile delivery model.
Professional and Educational Background
Senior Associate — 5-9 years of experience.
5+ years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance with a strong Controlling, Product Costing and Material Ledger component, with a minimum of 2 end-to-end implementations involving CO/PC/ML design, configuration, testing and deployment.
Any graduation degree, any post-graduation degree; CA/ICWA preferred.

Description:
Fortis Healthcare Ltd is looking for Senior Resident Anaesthesiology to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
As a Senior Resident in Anaesthesiology, your role is to provide specialized medical care and expertise in the field of anaesthesiology
You will work in a clinical or hospital setting, collaborating with surgeons, physicians, and other healthcare professionals to ensure the safe administration of anaesthesia during surgical procedures and the effective management of perioperative care
Here are some key responsibilities and tasks associated with this role:Preoperative Assessment: Conduct thorough preoperative assessments of patients, evaluating their medical history, physical condition, and any pre-existing conditions or medications that may impact anaesthesia
Determine the appropriate anaesthetic plan for each patient
Anaesthesia Administration: Administer various types of anaesthesia, including general anaesthesia, regional anaesthesia, and monitored anaesthesia care, depending on the specific surgical procedure and patient needs
Monitor vital signs, adjust anaesthetic levels as necessary, and ensure patient comfort and safety throughout the procedure
Patient Monitoring: Continuously monitor and assess patient vital signs, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and end-tidal carbon dioxide levels
Utilize advanced monitoring techniques, such as arterial lines, central venous catheters, and cardiac output monitors, to ensure optimal patient stability during surgery
Airway Management: Perform airway management techniques, including endotracheal intubation, mask ventilation, and the placement of advanced airway devices
Respond to airway emergencies and manage difficult airway situations effectively
Intraoperative Support: Collaborate closely with surgeons and surgical teams to provide intraoperative support, including fluid management, blood transfusion management, and rapid response to changes in patient status
Administer additional medications or interventions as required

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Job Title: .NET Developer


Experience: 5 to 8 Years


Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer with experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in .NET Framework/.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and web application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using .NET technologies.
Develop and maintain web applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices.
Optimize application performance and troubleshoot production issues.
Develop database objects such as stored procedures, functions, and triggers.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD implementations.
Work in Agile/Scrum development environments.
