Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example
Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals
Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals
Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance
Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team
Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns
Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate
Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Job Summary
State Operation - Manager
Full Time/ Arunachal Pradesh, Jharkhand and Andra Pradesh /Immediate
State Operations Manager will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and monitoring the implementation of the program in partnership with the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) at the state level. This role will ensure effective collaboration with state, district, and block-level teams, build the capacities of stakeholders, and drive alignment with program objectives. Foster and maintain strong partnerships with the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) and other key stakeholders.
Lead and oversee program implementation across the state, ensuring timely execution, quality delivery, and effective monitoring of activities.
Provide capacity-building support to SRLM teams at state, district, and block levels.
Facilitate collaboration with government departments, community institutions, and other stakeholders to achieve program objectives.
Drive effective internal and external communication to ensure alignment and transparency.
Develop, review, and maintain comprehensive program documentation, progress reports, and IEC materials.
Skills and Competencies
Proven experience in program implementation, monitoring, and reporting
Ability to coordinate with government stakeholders, community institutions
Strong understanding of rural development and livelihood promotion
Strong leadership and team management abilities
Effective stakeholder engagement and partnership-building skills
Ability to work independently while driving collaboration across multiple levels.
High adaptability and resilience in field-driven environments
We encourage women candidates to apply.

Description:
Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

The Cinema Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the cinema, ensuring smooth daily operations, excellent guest experience, team performance, and achievement of business targets.

Ensure excellent customer service and handle guest complaints effectively.

Experience: 4 to 7 years in cinema, hospitality, retail, QSR, or similar operations.
Strong leadership and people-management skills.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of sales, revenue, cost control, and P&L.
Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and holidays.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Key Performance Areas
Revenue & profitability
Guest satisfaction
Team productivity & retention
Operational compliance
Cost & inventory control
Cinema hygiene, safety & service standards
Overall cinema performance

Description:
Geologist Position: Geologist Project: HEO 240 MW Hydro Electric Project Location: Project Site, Arunachal Pradesh Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based Experience Required: 7 to 10 years (Targeting ~7 years) Qualification
M.Sc. in Geology (Mandatory requirement).
Strong theoretical and practical foundation in structural geology, lithostratigraphy, and field mapping techniques.
Experience Overview
Minimum 7 years of post-qualification field experience in geological mapping, surface and subsurface data collection, and geotechnical/rock mass assessments, preferably within large-scale infrastructure, mining, or hydropower projects in complex mountainous regions (such as the Himalayas).
Key Responsibilities
Field Mapping & Face Logging: Conduct rigorous surface and underground geological mapping (rock outcrops, quarry sites, tunnel faces, and dam foundations) and maintain accurate lithological and structural logs.
Structural & Rock Mass Analysis: Measure and analyze structural data (joints, faults, shear zones, dip/strike) and evaluate rock mass quality using standard empirical rating systems to understand ground behavior.
Core Drilling & Logging: Oversee exploratory core drilling programs, perform detailed physical core logging, and systematically collect representative rock and soil samples for laboratory testing.
Geological Hazard Identification: Spot and evaluate potential geological risks early-such as weak zones, active fault lines, unpredicted seepage, or unstable slopes-and provide critical inputs to the project management team.
Data Correlation & Mapping: Correlate surface mapping data with subsurface drilling logs to update geological cross-sections and structural models.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain comprehensive daily geological records, photographic logs, and technical reports for audits and client reviews.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with civil engineering and site execution teams, serving as the primary authority on ground conditions to help bridge science with construction realities.

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

Description:
Purpose/Objective


The Store Incharge oversees the efficient receipt, storage, and issuance of materials, ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures (SOP) and maintaining material quality.
This role coordinates with site store in-charges on material requisitions and vendor deliveries, manages inventory through regular monitoring and timely disposal of non-moving items, and handles financial and documentation management to ensure accurate records.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Store In-charge - Mining Stakeholder Liasioning: Liasion with site store in-charge to cordinate with material requisitions and vendor deliveries Obtain vendor reports from all sites on monthly basis and consolidate the same for providing inputs to Vendor Development Lead and senior management.
Material Handling and Procurement: Ensure efficient receipt, storage, and issuance of various materials in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP).
Coordinate material collection from the vendors for material procured or services sourced.
Implement appropriate storage methods tailored to different categories of materials to maintain their quality and integrity.
Oversee PR and verify stock availability before approving PRs to facilitate timely procurement.
Ensure the closure of open goods receipt/invoice receipt (GR/IR) issues to maintain accurate inventory records.
Employ effective handling methods to prevent material damage.
Inventory Management: Authorize RGP/NRGP material gate passes and define ROL and ROQ for fast-moving items in collaboration with user and commercial departments to optimize inventory management Ensure timely monitoring and disposal of non-moving items nearing expiration, following established procedures.
Oversee regular physical verification of inventory in accordance with SOP.
Financial and Documentation Management: Maintain records encompassing store registers and material requisition slips (MRS).
Enter invoices into the system to enable Contract Admin / ABEX for doing MIRO and subsequent release of payment.
Operational Management and Reporting: Facilitate daily review meetings with store team members to promptly address and resolve any outstanding issues.
Respond to internal and external audit queries, provide necessary data, and implement corrective actions for audit observations.
Ensure compliance with IMS standards in all store processes and data management activities.
Oversee GRN, quality, DCC, and MRS posting in SAP.
Compile monthly MIS reports on inventory aging, non-moving items (NMI), and project inventory, and distribute them to relevant stakeholders.
Technology Utilization: Leverage digital tools to streamline store operations, including order processing, stock management, and supplier coordination.
Develop and maintain digital records for store transactions and inventory, enhancing accuracy and transparency in store operations.
Key Stakeholders - Internal Site Store In-charges Finance Team Operations Team Quality Assurance Team Key Stakeholders - External Vendors Suppliers Regulatory Authorities
Technical Competencies


Category Management-NR,Contract Management-PRJ,Contractor Management-NR,Data Analysis and Reporting-NR,Digitization & Automation-NR,Inventory Management-PRJ,Market Intelligence Understanding-NR,Mining Business Know-how-NR,NR Business Know How-NR,Sourcing Strategy and Execution-NR
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Work Experience (Range of years): 3-5 years of work experience

*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Role: Area Operations Manager

Direct Reportees: Store Managers

Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.

Description: 

You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.

- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors

- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above

- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.

- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into

Business plans.

- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.

- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent

- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication

- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for

- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from

The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

Documentation

Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record

Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training

Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

1) Job Purpose
To supervise excavation and delivery of the specified quantity and quality of bauxite from the assigned area of the Gurdari mines in the Netarhat cluster to the alumina refinery at Renukoot.
To execute the mine plan, MIS reporting, Budgeting, sustainable Mining Operation & implementation of digitization /Automation in mining activities.

3) Job Context & Major Challenges:Job Context:
Hindalco Industries Limited operates 5 bauxite mines across the Netarhat cluster in Jharkhand, about 95-100 km from Lohardaga Railway siding with an extraction capacity of 1,50,000 tons per year. The Amtipani mines caters to alumina refineries at Muri. Bauxite is transported through tippers by road and shipped through train from the railway siding at Tori. Once mining plan is finalized in collaboration with the Geological department and approved by the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), mining operation is undertaken at the mines primarily through contractual manpower & departmental manpower both. Laterite is removed, bauxite is drilled, excavated through excavators, and dumped through dumpers and unloaded in crusher hover or in bauxite stock room. At the end of the mining lifecycle, the waste is removed and used in back filling of closed mine pits and making them ready for plantation.

This role is responsible for supervising the excavation at the assigned area of the Gurdari mines to assist in delivering planned quantity and quality of bauxite in accordance with the approved Mining Plan and dispatch the same after a stringent quality assurance process that involves proper segregation after QA verification to the alumina refineries at Muri.
Criticality is achievement of quantity and quality of bauxite through maximum productivity in area under jurisdiction.

This role is expected to contribute to controlling costs through optimum deployment and utilization of resources including manpower, consumables, and spares in assigned area of the mine. This role must facilitate upkeep of equipment and infrastructure as well as good housekeeping under jurisdiction so that continuous production can be maintained.

A key element of the role is to implement safety protocols with respect to both man and materials in area under jurisdiction. It involves participating in safety propaganda and continuously checking PPE usage. It also involves supervising the blasting process with due permissions from explosive department in compliance of PESO norms.

Partnering sustainability through Mine Restoration as mandated by law for management of eco system of mining areas. It involves supervision of back filling of exhausted mines Harmonious relations with the local community and government officials is an important aspect of the role.
The new aspect of this role is to implement the new initiatives related to digitization, automation, and sustainability in various mining operations.

Facilitating preventive and predictive maintenance as well as breakdown maintenance of all equipment under jurisdiction to have continuous uptime of the equipment and non-stop production
2) Cost
Controlling cost of production and achieving cost saving without compromising delivery by driving continuous process improvement across area of operation
3) Cash
Improving profitability by optimizing working capital through inventory management and spare consumption patterns without compromising on safety and environment aspects
4) Customer

Description:
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Group Company: Marks and Spencer Reliance India Private Limited

Designation: Store Manager

Office Location:

Position description: As a Store Manager, you will lead the operations of your business unit while ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers. Your key responsibilities will include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Operational Leadership:

? Day-to-Day Management: Oversee the smooth running of the store, maintaining high standards across all operations, and ensuring legal compliance, particularly regarding pricing and product display.

? Procedure Adherence: Execute operational procedures efficiently, ensuring consistency and excellence in areas such as housekeeping, fitting rooms, and checkout processes.

? Quality Control: Monitor product quality, address any issues swiftly, and communicate feedback to the merchandising team to uphold superior product standards.

2. Sales Performance Management:

? Target Achievement: Drive and monitor the achievement of sales goals for your department. You?ll also play a key role in setting realistic yet ambitious targets, with the flexibility to adapt based on performance trends.

? Sales Analysis: Track sales performance continuously, taking timely corrective actions when necessary to meet or exceed sales objectives.

? Team Communication: Regularly share updates on department, store, and regional performance with your team, ensuring transparency and motivating everyone towards common goals.

3. Customer Experience:

? Customer Service Excellence: Lead by example in delivering exceptional customer service, creating a welcoming atmosphere for every visitor.

? Building Relationships: Understand customer needs, cultivate rapport, and establish loyal relationships with key clientele.

? Handling Feedback: Take ownership of customer complaints and queries, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions that turn challenges into positive outcomes.

4. Visual Merchandising Store Presentation:

? Merchandising Standards: Ensure that all visual merchandising guidelines are followed to create an attractive and engaging shopping environment.

? Continuous Improvement: Provide constructive feedback to visual merchandisers to enhance the store's visual appeal and product presentation.

5. Shrinkage Inventory Control:

? Loss Prevention: Implement best practices to minimize shrinkage by training staff on merchandise handling and stock protection, safeguarding store assets.

6. Team Development Leadership:

? Training Development: Facilitate on-the-job training, product knowledge sessions, and visual merchandising workshops to equip your team with the skills needed for success.

? Role Clarity Task Delegation: Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each team member, ensuring accountability and efficient task management.

? Constructive Feedback: Regularly provide feedback that helps your team identify strengths and areas for improvement, fostering continuous personal and professional growth.

? Motivation Engagement: Inspire your team to not only meet sales targets but also to follow operational procedures with enthusiasm and dedication.

7. Cashier Support Training:

? Support Supervision: Assist in the training of cashiers and provide ongoing support to ensure smooth operations at checkout, contributing to a positive customer experience.

Location: Bokaro, Jharkhand
Experience: Minimum 2 Years

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced HSE Officer to ensure workplace safety, compliance, and implementation of HSE standards at the project/site.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and monitor HSE policies, procedures, and safety standards.
Conduct site safety inspections, risk assessments, and toolbox talks.
Identify hazards and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure compliance with statutory safety requirements.
Monitor PPE usage, work permits, and safe work practices.
Investigate incidents/near-misses and prepare reports.
Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly HSE reports and documentation.
Conduct safety training and awareness programs for workers.
Coordinate with site/project teams to maintain a safe working environment.



Requirements
Minimum 2 years of HSE/Safety experience .
Relevant HSE/Safety qualification preferred.
Candidates from Narayani, Patna University, RLI, or CLI preferred.
Experience in industrial/project/site safety preferred.
Strong knowledge of safety procedures, risk assessment, and statutory compliance.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Willingness to work site-based in Bokaro .

Description:
Job Description for Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals:

As a Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals, you will play a key role in promoting and selling our healthcare services to potential patients and clients. Your primary responsibilities will include identifying sales opportunities, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and providing exceptional customer service. You will work closely with the healthcare team to understand our offerings and effectively communicate the benefits of our services to customers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Engage with potential patients and provide them with detailed information about healthcare services offered by Manipal Hospitals.
- Conduct market research to identify prospective clients and generate leads.
- Develop and maintain relationships with referral sources, such as physicians and community organizations.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to create promotional materials and campaigns that highlight our services.
- Meet and exceed sales targets and objectives.
- Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system.
- Attend industry events and health fairs to represent Manipal Hospitals and connect with potential clients.
- Provide feedback to the management team on market trends and customer needs.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent negotiation and persuasive abilities.
- Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to providing exceptional service.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in healthcare or a related field, is a plus.
- Knowledge of healthcare services and an understanding of the sales process.

Roles and Responsibilities
About the Role:
The Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and stakeholders. This role is critical in promoting our healthcare services and driving patient engagement. The Sales Associate will collaborate closely with various teams to enhance service delivery and ensure customer satisfaction.

About the Team:
You will be part of a dynamic sales team dedicated to expanding Manipal Hospitals' reach in the healthcare market. The team comprises skilled professionals who are passionate about providing exceptional service and support to patients. Collaboration and a customer-centric approach are key values within the team.

You are Responsible for:
Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within the healthcare sector.
Achieving sales targets and contributing to the overall growth of Manipal Hospitals.
Building and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals, patients, and other stakeholders.
Conducting market research to understand customer needs and competitive landscape.
Participating in promotional events and activities to raise awareness about the services offered.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
A strong background in sales, preferably in the healthcare industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients.
Strong analytical skills to assess market trends and customer needs.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive and positive attitude, along with a passion for healthcare service.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities
We are looking for an experienced Fire Protection Design Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of experience in the fire protection design industry.
Design and develop fire protection systems for commercial, residential, industrial, and other building projects.
Prepare detailed 2D and 3D fire protection system designs using Autodesk Revit.
Develop coordinated BIM models, layouts, shop drawings, and design documentation.
Design systems in accordance with applicable NFPA and BS/EN standards and project requirements.
Work on fire sprinkler, fire hydrant, hose reel, fire pump, fire suppression, and related fire protection systems.
Perform hydraulic calculations and equipment/system sizing where required.
Coordinate fire protection designs with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and other building services.
Review drawings and ensure designs comply with project specifications and relevant codes and standards.
Identify and resolve design clashes and technical issues during the design and coordination process.
Prepare design drawings, specifications, calculations, and other technical documentation.
Support project teams during design development, coordination, and drawing revisions.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Fire Protection Design.
Strong practical knowledge of fire protection system design.
Proficient in Autodesk Revit, particularly for 3D fire protection/BIM design and modelling.
Good knowledge of relevant NFPA and BS/EN standards.
Experience with fire sprinkler, hydrant, hose reel, fire pump, and other fire protection systems.
Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
Experience with BIM coordination and clash detection is preferred.
Strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Candidates must have hands-on experience in fire protection design and Revit-based 3D modelling.
AboutCompany:
R.K Fire Safety Technology is a fire protection engineering and design company providing professional fire protection services across the USA, UK, and Europe. We support clients with reliable, code-compliant fire protection solutions for a wide range of commercial, residential, industrial, and infrastructure projects.
Our services include fire protection system design, BIM and 3D modelling, sprinkler system design, fire hydrant and hose reel systems, fire pump systems, hydraulic calculations, and technical documentation. Our designs are developed in accordance with relevant NFPA and BS/EN standards and project requirements.
We combine technical expertise, industry standards, and Revit-based 3D/BIM design to deliver coordinated and practical fire protection solutions that help clients achieve safe, compliant, and efficient building designs.

Job Summary
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
The Associate, Numeracy Field will support the Program Officer in strengthening foundational numeracy implementation in Ramgarh, Jharkhand through district and block-level planning, technical support, government system strengthening, supervision of Project Field Coordinators, data use, monitoring, and documentation. The Associate will work closely with district and block education officials, including BEEOs, BPOs, BPMs, BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and DIET, to strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission. The position will also support academic platforms such as Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews and Gurugosthi, ensuring that these platforms use implementation and foundational numeracy data to identify priorities, develop action plans and follow up on agreed actions.
The Associate will report to the Program Officer and will supervise and provide technical and mentoring support to Project Field Coordinators in assigned blocks.


Responsibilities

Programme Planning, Management & Implementation
Develop a strong understanding of Room to Reads Foundational Numeracy program design and the NIPUN Bharat guidelines, NCF-FS, NCF-SE and SCF-Jharkhand.
Support the district lead in planning, coordinating, and implementing district foundational numeracy priorities within the DPMU structure, ensuring alignment with program goals and budgets.
Develop and maintain district, block, cluster, BRP, CRP, and school profiles to identify numeracy implementation priorities and prepare district heat maps for targeted academic support.
Flag key implementation issues, coordinate timely resolution with programme teams and DEO/BEO and BRP/CRP, and support the delivery of planned activities.
Plan and monitor implementation strategies based on priority areas, ensuring effective allocation of Project Field Coordinators (PFCs), training, mentoring, and follow-up support.
Supervise PFCs by reviewing monthly work plans, monitoring field performance, ensuring data quality, and strengthening their technical and mentoring capacities.
Support and facilitate numeracy training programmes, academic review meetings, and professional learning platforms for BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers, and teachers, in coordination with the district lead and relevant government stakeholders.
Represent the numeracy programme at relevant district- and block-level forums, as assigned, and maintain effective coordination and professional relationships with government stakeholders.


Technical & Academic Support for Foundational Numeracy
Provide technical support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom practices, assessment and academic mentoring to BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and Teachers.
Support government stakeholders to implement foundational numeracy practices consistently during school visits, mentoring visits, and academic review discussions at district and block levels.
Support DEO and BEO in coordination with District lead to analyze and use foundational numeracy assessment data to identify block-wise learning gaps, prioritize areas for academic support, and informed evidence-based planning and decision-making.
Conduct and support foundational numeracy-focused classroom observations and provide constructive, actionable feedback to PFCs and academic support personnel.
Support PFCs in using foundational numeracy assessment data to identify childrens learning needs and plan appropriate academic support to teachers.
Support the development, adaptation and use of numeracy observation tools, training resources and guidance materials in collaboration with DIET and district education officials.
Strengthen the technical capacity of PFCs to provide effective support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom observation, academic mentoring, and data use.
Strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission through coordinated engagement with district, block, cluster, school, and DIET stakeholders.
Track action points from Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews, and Gurugosthi, and support officials to close agreed actions within defined timelines.
Stay updated on relevant national and state education policies and initiatives, including NEP 2020, NIPUN Bharat, NCF and SCF-Jharkhand, and support the Program Officer in translating relevant priorities into district and block-level implementation.


Supervision & Field Support
Conduct regular joint visits with district and block education officials and Project Field Coordinators as per defined touchpoints to provide supportive supervision, technical guidance, and implementation monitoring.
Support DEO and BEO in reviewing the district and block-wise progress towards the overall goals and learning outcomes of the NIPUN Bharat Mission, identifying key bottlenecks, and strengthening academic support strategies to improve foundational numeracy learning outcomes.
Review field observations, implementation progress, and data submitted by Project Field Coordinators (PFCs) to ensure timely reporting, data quality, and adherence to programme standards.
Analyse monitoring, assessment, and implementation data to identify trends, implementation gaps, and priority areas, and provide actionable insights to support programme planning, implementation, and decision-making.
Prepare and submit timely weekly, monthly, and other programme reports, documenting key achievements, challenges, lessons learned, action points and recommendations for continuous programme improvement.


Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning
Collaborate with the Data and Evaluation team to implement and maintain programme monitoring and evaluation activities.
Support the district lead in the synthesis of monitoring and evaluation findings and preparation of concise programme summaries.
Use evidence from classroom observations, assessments, and implementation data to identify programme quality issues & gaps and prioritize block-wise priorities and support continuous improvement.


Qualifications
Required:
Bachelor's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent
Master's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent preferred
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector, particularly in foundational learning, teacher support, academic mentoring, school improvement, education programmes or related areas.
In-depth knowledge of foundational numeracy, its pedagogies, and classroom implementation strategies.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good interpersonal skills and a team player
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.
Room to Read is a child-safe organization. All personnel must adhere to Room to Read's Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention.

Job Details
Position Title: Distict Project Coordinator
Number of Position: 1
Reporting: State Program Manager
Location: Garhwa, Jharkhand
Type: Project Based
Qualifications
Qualification Required: Master s degree in social work, Child Rights, or related field.
Experience
Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in child protection, social protection or Community development.
Prior experience of working at the district level
Experience of handling responsibilities of coordination with Government departments
Experience in working with government stakeholders, child and social protection mechanisms,
Skills & Attributes
Proactive and solution-oriented person.
Possess communication and facilitation skills.
In-depth understanding of child protection schemes and architecture in Jharkhand.
Knowledge and experience of working with Panchayati Raj Institutions preferably in Jharkhand, is desirable.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in Hindi and English language.
Digital literacy including word processing database systems and PowerPoint.
Strong command of excel and budget management is a plus
About the Project
Project Concern International (PCI) India, with support from UNICEF, will implement the initiative in Jharkhand titled Convergent approach towards adolescent empowerment, reduction of child marriage and violence against women and children, prevention of family separation and strengthening social protection, focusing on equity. The project aims to prevent child marriage and violence against women and children, reduce family separation, and strengthen social protection systems with a strong focus on equity. The key focus of this project is to strengthen preventive work around ending child marriage, violence against children and promote prevention from family separation and social protection linkages through existing government platforms, programs and schemes. This project is to provide technical support to district administration in strengthening institutional mechanisms including child protection systems and convergence between government and non-governmental organizations for updating, implementing and reviewing district specific implementation plans and other interventions and targeted actions to accelerate reduction in child marriage in districts with high or increasing prevalence with focus on equity. It also includes supporting district to develop and implement social behaviour change strategies to address harmful social norms of child marriage and violence, capacity building of stakeholders, and facilitate identification and support to vulnerable children and their families. This comprehensive initiative operates at both systemic and community levels to create sustainable, equity-focused change in 12 high-prevalence districts and 9 tribal blocks. A dedicated project team will drive the initiatives forward by facilitating convergence among departments (WCD, Rural Development, JSLPS, PRI and others), enhancing CSO capacity, institutionalizing community based monitoring systems, and document best practices to inform state policy. This partnership seeks to catalyze systemic change, strengthen government-CSO coordination, and accelerate Jharkhand s progress toward becoming child marriage-free while ensuring protection and empowerment for all adolescents.
Key Responsibilities
Facilitate in district-level implementation of the project, under the guidance of state team and leadership of district administration, achieving restits within the stipdated time frame.
Facilitate development/update, implernentation, and review of District Action/lmplementation Plans to end child marriage and violence against children and adolescent empowerment with integration of Mental Health Psycho-SociaI Support and Family Based Care components.
Strengthen coordination among District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Child Wdfare Committees, Police, Education, Jharkhand State Livelihood Promotion Society, Panchayati Raj Institution, District Legal Services Authority, and Civil Society Organizations for integrated case management and reducing vulnerabilities through linkages with various schemes of the government including sponsorship, foster care, Savitri bai Phule Scheme, etc.
Co-ordinate with Panchayati Raj Department for strengthening Standing Committee on Women and Child Development (Child Welfare Protection Committee), DLCC and operationalising Gram panchayat Help Desks as social protection clinics and activating Child Welfare Protection Committees in selected blocks.
Support in organizing and facilitate quarterly review meetings to track implementation of child protection plans and convergence mechanisms at Nie district level.

Description:
World Change Starts with Educated Children
IMPORTANT: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
The Associate, Numeracy Field will support the Program Officer in strengthening foundational numeracy implementation in Ramgarh, Jharkhand through district and block-level planning, technical support, government system strengthening, supervision of Project Field Coordinators, data use, monitoring, and documentation. The Associate will work closely with district and block education officials, including BEEOs, BPOs, BPMs, BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and DIET, to strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission. The position will also support academic platforms such as Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews and Gurugosthi, ensuring that these platforms use implementation and foundational numeracy data to identify priorities, develop action plans and follow up on agreed actions.
The Associate will report to the Program Officer and will supervise and provide technical and mentoring support to Project Field Coordinators in assigned blocks.
Responsibilities
Programme Planning, Management & Implementation
Develop a strong understanding of Room to Reads Foundational Numeracy program design and the NIPUN Bharat guidelines, NCF-FS, NCF-SE and SCF-Jharkhand.
Support the district lead in planning, coordinating, and implementing district foundational numeracy priorities within the DPMU structure, ensuring alignment with program goals and budgets.
Develop and maintain district, block, cluster, BRP, CRP, and school profiles to identify numeracy implementation priorities and prepare district heat maps for targeted academic support.
Flag key implementation issues, coordinate timely resolution with programme teams and DEO/BEO and BRP/CRP, and support the delivery of planned activities.
Plan and monitor implementation strategies based on priority areas, ensuring effective allocation of Project Field Coordinators (PFCs), training, mentoring, and follow-up support.
Supervise PFCs by reviewing monthly work plans, monitoring field performance, ensuring data quality, and strengthening their technical and mentoring capacities.
Support and facilitate numeracy training programmes, academic review meetings, and professional learning platforms for BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers, and teachers, in coordination with the district lead and relevant government stakeholders.
Represent the numeracy programme at relevant district- and block-level forums, as assigned, and maintain effective coordination and professional relationships with government stakeholders.
Technical & Academic Support for Foundational Numeracy
Provide technical support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom practices, assessment and academic mentoring to BRPs, CRPs, Head Teachers and Teachers.
Support government stakeholders to implement foundational numeracy practices consistently during school visits, mentoring visits, and academic review discussions at district and block levels.
Support DEO and BEO in coordination with District lead to analyze and use foundational numeracy assessment data to identify block-wise learning gaps, prioritize areas for academic support, and informed evidence-based planning and decision-making.
Conduct and support foundational numeracy-focused classroom observations and provide constructive, actionable feedback to PFCs and academic support personnel.
Support PFCs in using foundational numeracy assessment data to identify childrens learning needs and plan appropriate academic support to teachers.
Support the development, adaptation and use of numeracy observation tools, training resources and guidance materials in collaboration with DIET and district education officials.
Strengthen the technical capacity of PFCs to provide effective support on foundational numeracy pedagogy, classroom observation, academic mentoring, and data use.
Strengthen government-led academic support systems under the NIPUN Bharat Mission through coordinated engagement with district, block, cluster, school, and DIET stakeholders.
Track action points from Cluster Academic Meetings, Block Academic Reviews, and Gurugosthi, and support officials to close agreed actions within defined timelines.
Stay updated on relevant national and state education policies and initiatives, including NEP, NIPUN Bharat, NCF and SCF-Jharkhand, and support the Program Officer in translating relevant priorities into district and block-level implementation.
Supervision & Field Support
Conduct regular joint visits with district and block education officials and Project Field Coordinators as per defined touchpoints to provide supportive supervision, technical guidance, and implementation monitoring.
Support DEO and BEO in reviewing the district and block-wise progress towards the overall goals and learning outcomes of the NIPUN Bharat Mission, identifying key bottlenecks, and strengthening academic support strategies to improve foundational numeracy learning outcomes.
Review field observations, implementation progress, and data submitted by Project Field Coordinators (PFCs) to ensure timely reporting, data quality, and adherence to programme standards.
Analyse monitoring, assessment, and implementation data to identify trends, implementation gaps, and priority areas, and provide actionable insights to support programme planning, implementation, and decision-making.
Prepare and submit timely weekly, monthly, and other programme reports, documenting key achievements, challenges, lessons learned, action points and recommendations for continuous programme improvement.
Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning
Collaborate with the Data and Evaluation team to implement and maintain programme monitoring and evaluation activities.
Support the district lead in the synthesis of monitoring and evaluation findings and preparation of concise programme summaries.
Use evidence from classroom observations, assessments, and implementation data to identify programme quality issues & gaps and prioritize block-wise priorities and support continuous improvement.
Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent
Master's degree in education / mathematics / social sciences or equivalent preferred
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector, particularly in foundational learning, teacher support, academic mentoring, school improvement, education programmes or related areas.
In-depth knowledge of foundational numeracy, its pedagogies, and classroom implementation strategies.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good interpersonal skills and a team player
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.

People Operations & Employee Relations:

Provide day-to-day support to employees on People Operations-related queries and coordinate with the appropriate team members for timely resolution.

Employee Documentation & Records Management:

Administration & Coordination:

Maintain appropriate records and documentation for audit and internal review purposes.
Ensure timely submission of required documentation and follow up on pending approvals or discrepancies.

Required:

24 years of relevant professional experience in People Operations, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, HR Administration, or a related function.
Working knowledge of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
General understanding of personnel administration and HR practices.
Good coordination, follow-up, and documentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to interact effectively with employees and stakeholders at different levels.
Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and Word.
Ability to maintain confidentiality while handling employee information and records.

Preferred:

Prior experience in the development/non-profit sector or a multi-location organization.
Experience in handling HR documentation, employee queries, recruitment coordination, bills, and administrative processes.

1) Job Purpose

3) Job Context & Major Challenges:Job Context:
Hindalco Industries Limited operates 4 bauxite mines across the Lohardaga cluster in Chhattisgarh. Bagru plateau in the Lohardaga cluster, with composite deposit of bauxite, has 2 operating mines (4 leases) about 20 km from Lohardaga. The Bagru mines cater to alumina refineries at Muri and Renukoot. Besides transporting bauxite through tippers by road, bauxite is shipped through train from the railway siding at Lohardaga which gets bauxite through an aerial ropeway from the Bagru mines. Once mining plan is finalised in collaboration with the Geological department and approved by the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), mining operation is undertaken at the mines primarily through contractual manpower. Laterite is removed, bauxite is drilled, excavated through excavators and dumped through dumpers and unloaded in crusher hover or in bauxite stock room. At the end of the mining lifecycle, the waste is removed and used in back filling of closed mine pits and making them ready for plantation through horticulture contract.

This is a statutory position. The role is responsible for measuring excavation area and submitting surface plan, geological plan, water danger plan to DGMS on a quarterly basis showing progress of excavation. It is critical to ensure measurement of length, breadth, width of excavated area and conduct proper risk analysis to ensure complete accuracy.

Another important element of the role is to estimate over burden, top soil, laterite over bauxite area and arrange for their removal through contractor. Close coordination with the contractor to check whether all resources in terms of manpower and equipment are being deployed and work is progressing as per plan. Criticality is to keep track of progress of work on the ground to ensure completion of tasks within deadline to make the mine ready for bauxite excavation and ensure payment as per actual work done. In view of the large contingents of contractual workers deployed for this process, contract labour management is a critical element of the role.

This role is required to undertake creation of green belt particularly for rehabilitation of mines. Water management through rain water harvesting is also an important element of the role. It involves dealing with the local community sometimes.

Harmonious community management

Monitoring intake and deployment of physically fit and appropriately trained contractual workforce and ensuring their continuous training and wellbeing as per company guidelines.
Monitoring implementation of contract management.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Procurement & Vendor Management:

Support the end-to-end procurement process in accordance with organizational procurement policies and procedures.
Identify vendors, obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements, coordinate reviews, obtain approvals, and maintain procurement documentation.
Maintain the vendor database and procurement documentation.
Monitor contract expiry dates and coordinate timely renewal or execution of new contracts.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
Verify vendor invoices, submit them to Finance on time, and follow up until payment is completed.
Maintain procurement records, agreements, purchase orders, and supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes.

Office Administration & Facilities Management

Responsible for the overall upkeep and day-to-day administration of the office.
Ensure timely payment of field office rent, electricity, water, internet, and other utility bills, and maintain proper records of the same.
Oversee the general upkeep and maintenance of the office premises, furniture, fixtures, and equipment, and coordinate timely repairs and servicing as required.
Coordinate with the landlord, service providers, and utility vendors for uninterrupted office services and address any related issues promptly.
Maintain adequate stock of office stationery, pantry items, housekeeping materials, and other office supplies.
Raise procurement requests for routine office requirements.
Ensure office safety, cleanliness, security, and compliance with organizational administrative standards.
Manage and monitor Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for office facilities and equipment, ensuring timely renewals, preventive maintenance, and uninterrupted service delivery.

Logistics, Events & Travel

Coordinate logistics arrangements for trainings, workshops, meetings, and program events.
Arrange venue bookings, accommodation, transportation, catering, and event materials as required.
Coordinate staff travel, including travel bookings and local transportation.
Support logistical planning for program implementation activities at district and field levels.
Inventory & Material Distribution:

Coordinate procurement, storage, packaging, dispatch, and distribution of program materials.
Maintain inventory registers and stock records for program materials at the field office.
Maintain fixed asset and non-fixed asset registers in accordance with organizational policies.
Support periodic physical verification of inventory and assets.
Coordinate with program teams to obtain material distribution acknowledgements and supporting documentation as applicable.
Ensure proper storage, movement, and record-keeping of program materials.

Program Implementation & Documentation Support:

Provide administrative and operational support for program implementation activities.
Support data collection, data entry, verification, and database updates in organizational systems (including GSD or other designated platforms).
Assist in data validation and periodic data cleaning to maintain accuracy.
Extend support Program Field Coordinators and Program Assistants during district, block, school, and community-level events, including documentation, photography, and other logistical assistance as required.
Render support to the Program Field Coordinators/Program Assistants in rolling out community-level events and district/block/school-level workshops/meetings/events by documenting the meeting, clicking photographs, and any other support as required.
Prepare, type, format, and maintain program documents in English and Hindi, including managing electronic records, SharePoint folders, and file conversions as required.
Prepare meeting minutes, maintain documentation, and follow up on agreed action points.
Perform other administrative and documentation tasks assigned by the reporting manager.

Stakeholder Coordination & Relationships:

Coordinate closely with concerned Program, Finance, Procurement, and Administration teams to ensure timely support for program activities.
Ensure effective liaison w Liaise with vendors, service providers, landlords, government offices, and other external stakeholders as required.
Respond promptly to administrative requests from field teams while ensuring compliance with organizational policies.
Maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support efficient program delivery.

Compliance & Reporting:

Ensure all procurement and administrative activities comply with organizational policies, donor requirements, and statutory regulations.
Maintain complete documentation for procurement, inventory, payments, and office administration.
Support internal and external audits by providing required records and documentation.
Prepare periodic administrative and procurement reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile

Required:

Graduate in any discipline.
23 years of relevant experience in administration, procurement, logistics, or office management, preferably in the NGO, development, or social sector.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
Willingness to travel frequently within the states.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Self-motivated, flexible, and able to work without close supervision.
Attention to detail.
High standards of integrity, honesty, and professionalism.
Strong negotiation skills.

Preferred:

Flexible attitude towards changing priorities and ability to multi-task with an eye for detail.
Strong initiative, proactive, and solution oriented.
Team player.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

Please share your resume at Ranjan.Singh@roomtoread.org.

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Analyst
Corporate Title: Analyst
Location: Jaipur
Responsibilities
The person will be responsible for day-to-day review of voice logs between Client Relationship Managers (RC) and clients where trade details are discussed and agreed. They need to ensure that all key trade-related details are clearly discussed, accurately captured, and documented in the applicable product-specific template. The role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to defined review standards, timely completion of assigned production duties, and appropriate escalation of exceptions, missing information, or first-level queries within the pre-specified timelines. The candidate should also act as a backup for peers when required and share best practices with the team to support consistent quality delivery.
Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details have been discussed and agreed as per the required standards.
Listen to and understand client discussions conducted in English and Chinese language (Mandarin and Cantonese) and accurately document the agreed details in English or the prescribed business template, as applicable.
Complete the relevant product-specific voice log review template with accurate details, observations, and outcome of the review.
Identify and highlight missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions to the relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of daily production activities in line with defined SLAs, cut-off times, and quality expectations.
Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Assist in preparing and reviewing daily control / production reports, including tracking of open items, exceptions, and follow-ups.
Support follow-up with RC / business teams for clarification or resolution of deficiencies noted during voice log review.
Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes to support internal control, audit, and management reporting requirements.
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders on complex cases, escalations, reporting requirements, and process improvements.
Act as backup for peers during absence and support knowledge sharing, cross-training, and continuous improvement within the team.
Perform other administration, reporting, and control-related tasks as assigned.
Your skills and experience
Minimum educational qualification: University graduate with a Bachelor s Degree.
Chinese Language Proficiency (Mandarin and/or Cantonese): Candidate must be able to understand spoken client conversations, interpret financial and investment terminology, and accurately document agreed trade details in English using prescribed Voice Log Review templates.
Good command of business English for accurate documentation, exception reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, banking / wealth management products, or control review processes will be an added advantage.
Strong listening, comprehension, documentation, and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential control issues from recorded conversations.
Candidates are required to be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Highly motivated, quality-focused, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to multi-task and work under pressure to meet production timelines, cut-off times, and quality standards.
Good communication skills and ability to manage routine queries / first-level escalations professionally.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Company: Startek

Process: Zomato Blended Process (Voice + Chat)

Department: Customer Support / Operations

About the Role

Startek is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused individuals for the Zomato Blended Process. The role involves handling customer queries through voice and chat channels while ensuring a smooth and satisfactory customer experience.

Roles & Responsibilities

Handle customer queries and concerns through inbound calls and chat support.
Provide accurate information and effective resolutions to customer issues.

Maintain professional communication and ensure high customer satisfaction.
Follow company policies, process guidelines, and quality standards.
Manage customer interactions efficiently while meeting performance and productivity targets.
Escalate complex issues to the concerned department whenever required.
Maintain proper documentation and records of customer interactions.

Eligibility Criteria

Undergraduate and graduate candidates are eligible.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency in both Hindi and English is mandatory.
Basic computer knowledge and typing skills are required.
Candidates must possess their own laptop and a stable Wi-Fi connection.

Shift & Work Requirements

9-hour rotational shifts.
Rotational week-offs.
Night shifts included.
No leaves permitted during the first 90 days of joining.
Festival leaves are not available.

Benefits

PF and ESIC facilities.
Quarterly performance-based bonus.
Opportunity to work with a reputed organization.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.

Startek does not charge any fees or recruitment charges from candidates at any stage of the hiring process.

Integrated Facility management
Plan, manage, and oversee day-to-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.

Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.

Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.
Engineering and Technical Services

Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

Lead responses to all auditsinternal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads, CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk-free handovers and formal process closure.
Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.
Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management
Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M E, Events, Travel, etc.).
Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.
Security, EHS, and Business Continuity

Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.
Good knowledge of ISO standards like ISO45K, ISO27001, ISO14K, ISO22301.
